name: OkCredit
long_description:
Today, over 50 million SMBs issue informal credit in India, This is a hugely manual process which they spend hours tracking, reconciling, and collecting! 

The 50M SMBs in India account for 40% of the nation’s GDP. As much as 60% of their sales happen on credit. That’s ~24% of the country’s GDP (500B$) lying on paper!

OKCREDIT as a company came into existence to start solving the most important problem of credit recovery in MSMEs. We as first movers developed a bookkeeping app that would help any merchant sitting at the remotest corner of the country with internet connectivity to record his transactions digitally. We helped them track the credit given to their customers and suppliers. With our Okcredit app a merchant can track the amount of credit given, monitor credit limit, send reminders and eventually can collect faster from their customers. So as a company our vision was to bring the data dark merchants onto the digital platform. We have changed the way the MSMEs record the transactions and eased their life today.
one_liner: Simple and secure bookkeeping for Indian businesses.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: 1. Recovery of credit - MSMEs businesses run on a credit system. To run their business and sustain in the market they need to provide goods/services on credit, but recovery of this credit is the key challenge. 2. Working capital for the business - It’s difficult to get credit at a cheaper rate, you need to prove your credit worthiness to secure loans or provide collaterals to get loans.Most of the MSMEs are unserved, unidentified and underserved segments in an economy like India.3. Demand for customers - Due to the booming e-commerce market and pandemic situation , there is a paradigm shift in the purchasing habits. Most of the customer base has moved towards online purchases/transactions. Traditional merchants are facing tough competition to convert these customers.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: Vendr was founded in 2018 to make software buying fast, fair, and transparent. After joining Y Combinator in 2019, founder and CEO Ryan Neu built Vendr to help companies save money on SaaS through data-driven negotiations. Following its $150M Series B, Vendr evolved from a services-led business into an AI-first company, launching Ruth—the negotiation agent trained on the world’s largest dataset of SaaS pricing and negotiation insights—to help every buyer get a fair deal automatically.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Software sales is broken. Buying SaaS still feels manual, slow, and opaque—buyers don’t know what a fair price is, and sellers spend months negotiating instead of closing deals. After leading SMB sales at HubSpot through its IPO, Ryan saw firsthand how inefficient the process had become. In 2018, he founded Vendr to fix it. Today, Vendr’s AI negotiation agent, Ruth, uses real pricing and contract data to help buyers get fair deals instantly—turning a once painful process into a transparent, data-driven transaction.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long-term vision is to fix software sales by making every transaction data-driven and fair. If we succeed, no one will overpay for software again. Buyers will use AI agents like Ruth to get transparent, market-based prices instantly—and sellers will close deals faster with trust built in. Software buying will finally be as efficient and predictable as any other modern transaction.

launches.title: Kinter: agents that run your accounting close proactively, not on demand
launches.tagline: Kinter.ai is an autonomous workforce for accounting teams
launches.body:
I started coding at 10 and working professionally at 17. Five years ago, I built Alloy Automation (YC W20), an integration platform backed by a16z and YC that connected SaaS tools and powered financial workflows for companies like Amazon.

Last year, I made a call that felt risky: walked away from a growing business because I could see the moat eroding. Integration infrastructure was getting commoditized. We pivoted to [Kinter.ai](http://Kinter.ai).

Here's what we saw: The real problem in accounting is execution capacity, not data. Most finance teams close their books 14-21 days after month-end – not because they lack information, but because the work (reconciliation, accruals, journal entries) still happens manually. Every "AI" tool in the space is basically a co-pilot: you ask it something, it helps you do the work faster. The work still lands on a person.

**What we built**: AI agents that run accounting workflows proactively, inside existing ERPs (QuickBooks and NetSuite), without waiting to be prompted. One agent does payroll. Another monitors for accruals throughout the month and drafts proposals. Another reads invoice attachments to extract prepaid expense candidates. All actions go through a human approval step before touching the books. Full audit trail on everything.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jhWdPmLRGOk>

What surprised us building this:\
\
1\. The hardest part isn't the AI, it's the data. We had an early customer where we were silently missing 2,300 bills because of a pagination limit in the QBO API. No error, no warning. Just missing data. Reconciliation built on incomplete data isn't reconciliation.

2\. Finance teams aren't afraid of AI, they're waiting for it. We’ve had over 600+ conversations with Controllers & CFOs. The reaction to "an AI that does your close" wasn't fear. It was a relief. People went into accounting to solve hard problems, not to copy numbers between spreadsheets at 11pm.

3\. Trust is built incrementally. We shipped human-in-the-loop approval flows before broad autonomy. The confidence threshold to let an agent post a journal entry is higher than the threshold to let it flag an anomaly. We design for that explicitly.

4\. The integration layer we built at Alloy turned out to be the prerequisite. You can't build a trustworthy accounting agent if you can't reliably read bank feeds and write back to ERPs. The connectivity problem isn't solved by the model.

See more at [kinter.ai](http://kinter.ai) and read our manifesto here: kinter.ai/manifesto

launches.body:
**Modernbanc combines features from both Excel and Quickbooks to give founders the best way to track their business finances.**

* Say goodbye to imports/exports and outdated reports.
* Build ARR, Burn, or Runway trackers with live financial data in seconds.
* Drill down and identify unneeded spend.

[Book a call with us if monitoring live financial metrics is top of your mind.](https://modernbanc.com/?source=yclaunch)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84421&key=user_uploads/354461/07567780-ae7d-441b-9535-43b2bdb5e2ce)

## **Problem**

Let’s be honest - no one likes opening Quickbooks, yet it’s the place where your core financial data lives. This creates a disconnect between founders and their key financial metrics, leading to overspend, lack of confidence, and missed goals.

To get the answers you need, you’d typically export that data into a spreadsheet and then run some calculations.

However, the problem is that historically, your accounting software and spreadsheet have always been disconnected, relying on clunky extensions and periodic CSV dumps. This leads to broken, outdated spreadsheets and wasted time cleaning and managing data.

**Why do we still put up with this? We had to come up with a better solution.**

## Meet Modernbanc: If Quickbooks and Excel had a baby.

No more clunky sheets extensions or periodic CSV dumps. With Modernbanc you just connect your bank accounts and accounting software and point directly to live balances and transactions within a spreadsheet interface. It just works.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84421&key=user_uploads/354461/e6929f86-d479-4bde-800c-2c2982d15612)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84421&key=user_uploads/354461/2e8a798e-acd2-4cd7-9834-9548fcd9c8e3)

**Modernbanc offers the best of both worlds:**

* **Built like a spreadsheet.** Ready to handle any free-form calculations, works offline, and has instant interactions.
* **Powered by an integrated ledger**, ensuring your data is always up-to-date and reliable.

**We care about quality and craft.** Inspired by Linear, our product is powered by our internal sync engine for that snappy, offline-first experience and WebGL canvas for ultra-fast rendering and instant calculations.

### **What you can do:**

* **Make plans and projections based on real-time accounts and balances.**
* **Drill down and identify unneeded spend, break down live transactions into categories**
* **Look up historical balances (e.g., “What was the balance of my account a month ago?”).**
* **Maintain a full hierarchy of your accounts, revenue, and spend.**
* **Track inventory and ensure nothing goes unaccounted.**

### **What data sources do you support?**

While Modernbanc has an accounting system that you can store data in, you can connect the following data sources to stream data to Modernbanc:

* Your bank accounts
* Ledger data from Quickbooks
* Any custom source (You can create your own data sources within our UI).

### **Who is it for?**

* **Startups** looking to do expense reviews, building live Runway/Burn/Profitability trackers in minutes that don’t involve import/export and never need updating.
* **Finance teams at medium/large** companies that waste countless working hours on broken spreadsheets when putting together reports.
* Physical product startups who want to track inventory or other assets but find Quickbooks too limited.

### **Deal:**

* White-glove onboarding (we’ll build your financial views)
* Data migration.
* 2 months free for the first 10 clients that sign up through this launch.

### **NEXT STEPS?**

* Book a demo with us [**here,**](https://modernbanc.com/?source=yclaunch) and we’ll get you set up right away!
* Follow us on [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/modernbanc), [Twitt](https://x.com/modernbanc)[er](https://www.linkedin.com/company/modernbanc) and spread the word.

You can also reach us at [gregory@modernbanc.com](mailto:gregory@modernbanc.com) and [daniel@modernbanc.com](mailto:daniel@modernbanc.com). We’d love to help out if we can!

Sometimes a security or compliance breach can even kill your company!

### **Do you:**

* Need to store and protect customer data?
* Need to solve a hard encryption/security issue?

If the answer to any of these is yes then we can help you!

### **Introducing Encryption Vault.**

[**Modernbanc Vault**](https://modernbanc.com/vault) helps you securely collect, store, process and send sensitive data and achieve compliance.

You can get started in 5 minutes and do the following:

* Collect and encrypt data into the vault via our API proxy or by embedding our native SDKs.
* Process it by deploying custom code onto Modernbanc Isolates - bullet-proof and secure environments.
* Send this data to any API or a database.

It’s like wearing gloves - you have full control and can touch and manipulate your data with 0 exposure to your app or servers - it is magical!

### **Use-cases:**

You can use it to solve any security/encryption roadblocks but these use-cases would be most familiar:

* **Card/payments data:**
  * Working with card numbers or exposing it to your app/server puts you at risk of becoming subject to PCI compliance.
  * With Modernbanc you can delegate most of your PCI scope to us and launch your product in minutes!
  * Compliantly build custom payments journeys including a smart-checkout or payment orchestration.
* **Customer and credentials data:**
  * Show your customers and partners that you’re serious about their security by collecting and processing their data in bullet-proof encrypted environments.
* **Health data:**
  * Tick-off the PHI data collection, encryption and processing requirements for HIPPA.

launches.title: Abstra: Scale critical business processes with Python + AI
launches.tagline: Automate and manage operations with the power of code – without the overhead.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** [Abstra](https://abstra.io/?ref=yc-launch) is a Python-based workflow engine to design and manage custom business processes with no overhead, powered by AI. Merge automated tasks with manual reviews, gain real-time insights into operations, and track history with git-compatible versioning & auditable logs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80549&key=user_uploads/512795/6038e404-1f1f-4389-9d6c-304c36dadbfd)

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hUdQeX6dstY>

\
The Big Problem

Every company faces **growing pains** – new people must be **hired,** work needs to **scale**, more **compliance** regulations come knocking.

Suddenly, building **better internal processes** becomes critical – think onboarding, CS or financial systems. Ideally they're fast to build, easy to manage and audit, and intuitive for everyone.

However, the top of mind solutions have **tough trade-offs**.

* Choose no-code for **speed**, but lose customization and **auditability** – and end up with un-debuggable mess of automations no one truly understands.
* Opt to build in code for refinement, but sacrifice **months of expensive work** from engineers, who are focused on critical product tasks.

At this intersection of agility, power and governance, Abstra was born 🐣

### Our Workflows

With Abstra Workflows, teams can spin up robust **business process automation in Python** as fast as they would with no-code, freeing up valuable time.

Design and **orchestrate** fully custom flows for solutions that fit **seamlessly** into your processes.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80549&key=user_uploads/512795/0507502c-c2b3-4721-adf5-e2c087e28ae7)

And not only devs: with our AI features, **anyone with basic Python** skills can safely get **autonomy** from engineering teams. No technical overhead and countless **out-of-box benefits**, such as compliant logging, refined access control and custom notifications.

See beyond basic task automation to **tame** **critical** company **processes**, with **full visibility** into your challenges.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=80549&key=user_uploads/512795/b13697ea-1739-47f5-9bc4-35c456e173e9)

### How to get started

If you currently need to automate any company process and you tick one of these boxes:

* You are struggling with no or low-code tools
* You have critical scripts running locally in someone's machine
* You need to give non-technical team members autonomy
* You want visibility into how processes are being edited and executed
* You are a Python fan

Abstra was made for you. [Book a quick chat here](https://meet.abstra.app/sophia?url=yc-launch) – get 22% off if you sign up by May 8th.

Check out [abstra.io](http://abstra.io?ref=YC) for more!

launches.title: Sphere - Global sales tax / VAT / GST compliance powered by LLMs  🌎
launches.tagline: We help US companies sell anywhere in the world while remaining compliant.
launches.body:
### **TLDR**

[Sphere](https://www.getsphere.com/?utm_source=yclaunch&utm_medium=launchpost) puts global indirect tax compliance (i.e., sales tax, VAT, and GST) on autopilot - everything from nexus monitoring, registration, calculation / collection, filing, and remittance. Our AI-powered tax engine helps tech companies like Runway AI, Sierra AI and Codieum remain in compliance when selling to customers around the world. Want an estimate on your global indirect tax liability free of charge? [Talk to the Sphere team today](https://calendly.com/d/44n-bjc-wq7/meeting-with-sphere-team).

### **The problem**

When I ran [my last business](https://www.businessinsider.com/y-combinator-edtech-startup-sphere-seed-round-workplace-training-2022-8), we sold our product globally from day 1 and had a number of challenges with domestic and international tax compliance.

Specifically, we didn’t even know where/when we needed to pay sales tax, VAT, or GST, and even when we did, dealing with archaic government portals and filing on a regular basis was a royal pain in the behind. 

After talking to hundreds of finance leaders, we found similar pain points, and when it comes to indirect tax, companies either:

* **Ignore it,** but their tax liabilities accrue, and eventually, they have to pay the liability out of pocket, which can block future fundraises. Additionally, it is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore as tax authorities pass new regulations to clamp down on indirect tax evasion, especially for tech companies. 
* **Use an incumbent tax automation tool** (e.g. Avalara), but they don’t provide functionality for international coverage, are old/clunky, very expensive, and offer terrible support
* **Use local tax advisors,** which becomes incredibly expensive as you scale

### **Our solution**

Sphere’s platform puts international indirect tax compliance (i.e., sales tax, VAT, and GST) on autopilot:

_Step 1_: We integrate with your payment, billing, and HR solutions to help you see where in the world you’ve triggered economic or physical nexus and how big your indirect tax liability is.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83117&key=user_uploads/516489/d64c617f-1911-4b9d-a509-aa38218c8d7a)

_Step 2_: Once you know where you’re exposed you can register in any jurisdiction via our integrations with local tax authorities. We’ve done the heavy lifting of building these integrations to provide a holistic and superior customer experience (unlike other solutions that will push you to one of their international advisory partners)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83117&key=user_uploads/516489/2fd26632-aa74-4117-a949-691ba98a4c19)

_Step 3_: We leverage scraping technology and LLMs to collect, monitor, and process tax code data around the world (which is then verified by tax experts). Our AI tax engine integrates with your payment and billing provider to ensure you’re calculating and collecting tax correctly for your transactions based on 1. the product being sold and 2. the customer's location.  

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83117&key=user_uploads/516489/b171ff6b-e556-4bb0-9aee-9652ca25ea98)

_Step 4:_ We then file your tax returns in each jurisdiction and remit tax collected to local authorities - on time, every time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83117&key=user_uploads/516489/92a2e99e-18c3-4a94-bf6b-2909ffe49c48)

### **How we are different** 

* **True global coverage**: We’ve built out integrations with tax authorities around the world and are building a proprietary system that uses AI to collect and monitor tax data globally, providing compliance across sales tax, VAT, and GST. Other vendors will say they are ‘global’ but will offload you to an international partner for VAT / GST (which means a disjointed experience, more work for you, and more $$$ spent)
* **We're focused on fast-growing software / AI companies:** We are an extremely developer-friendly product (easy implementation, broad set of integrations, flexible APIs) and have the most transparent and reasonable pricing on the market ($100 / region/month all-inclusive)
* **Built with AI at the core**: Our tax engine is powered by an LLM trained on local + global tax legislation and tax rate data to ensure all your transactions are in compliance wherever you sell (other vendors do this research manually, which is hard to scale globally and prone to errors!).

### **Team** 

[Nick](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nicholasrudder/) comes from a finance background in the TMT sector (PwC, Macquarie) and experienced the pain of dealing with indirect tax firsthand in his last business, which was a B2C marketplace selling across the world. 

[Mehmood](https://www.linkedin.com/in/meshde/) and [Miguel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/miguelribeironeto/) built and optimized many of the cross-border compliance systems at Deel and were previously the founding engineers at Capbase (founded by YC alums), which helped businesses with entity setup and administrative compliance around the world.

We’re also lucky to have a team of indirect tax experts from companies like Uber, Avalara, and more. 

### **Vision** 

We are building an AI-powered cross-border compliance platform so that businesses can transact seamlessly around the world. 

As our engine ingests more compliance legislation from each region and becomes more robust with each customer, we will layer in additional cross-border services, including withholding tax, e-invoicing, and payments services, to further help businesses go global from day 1.    

**_We want to be the Deel for international billing._** 

By abstracting away compliance and cross-border payment admin, we believe this: 

* Levels the playing field for startups to compete against global incumbents
* Helps governments and local economies benefit more from international trade

### **Asks** 

* Want to better understand your tax liability? [Onboard with Sphere for free,](https://calendly.com/d/44n-bjc-wq7/meeting-with-sphere-team) and we’ll show you where you’re exposed and provide an estimate of your tax liability (we only charge once you register and file for a jurisdiction) 
* Know a CEO or finance leader who needs help with sales tax / VAT / GST or hates their current solution? Please reach out to me at [nicholas@getsphere.com](mailto:nicholas@getsphere.com) or feel free to send the below blurb to them.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\
A YC company called [Sphere](https://www.getsphere.com/?utm_source=yclaunch&utm_medium=referralblurb) has built an AI-powered indirect tax compliance platform that offers global coverage, easy implementation, and stellar support, all for a flat fee per region per month. They’re already helping global software and AI businesses like Runway AI, Sierra AI, Codeium, and many more. Book a time with them [here](https://calendly.com/d/44n-bjc-wq7/meeting-with-sphere-team).

launches.title: Rima: AI agents for document work accountants hate
launches.tagline: Rima interviews accountants, captures their edge cases, and automates the manual work
launches.body:
Hey everyone👋🏽,

It’s [Gana](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ggana/) & [Cedric](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cedric-foudjet-0470064b/) from [Rima ](https://www.getrima.ai/)

**TL;DR** 

Over 50% of accountants still receive client documents as email attachments, scans, and paper. They spend hours on formatting, data entry, and Excel wrangling before anything ever touches the ERP. Rima interviews these accountants, understands their edge cases and builds custom document workflows to automate this manual work. 

**ASK**: If you know accounting teams struggling with manual document workflows we’d love to speak with them - [founders@getrima.ai](mailto:founders@getrima.ai) 

**Launch Video** 

<https://youtu.be/e7PJRoFzmjE> 

**_Problem_**

When my mom's small business almost went bankrupt, it wasn't saved by software. It was saved by an accountant who used their brain to rescue the company. But today, these brilliant minds are stuck doing boring, repetitive work.

Over 50% of accountants still get client files as emails, scans, and paper. They waste hours on data entry and broken spreadsheets. Generic AI only gets 55% of the way there because it was never trained on your client's edge cases. That's why accountants say AI is dumb. It's not. It just doesn't have their context yet. 

We don't try to out-Claude Claude. We built Rima to solve the last mile: the library of edge cases (customer context) AI was never trained on so accountants can finally unlock its real value

**_Our Solution_**

Rima **interviews accountants** until it understands exactly how they want things done and **captures their unique edge cases**. Then, it builds a custom workflow to handle that task. \
\
We leverage what LLMs are good at - coding - and pair it with the **proprietary library of edge cases** that Rima collects across each client to build agentic workflows that are personalized and up to 99.7% accurate. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101608&key=user_uploads/533018/58582253-59ef-4bdd-b37e-7810d8c86ca5)

\
Rima learns from each client workflow and grows the library of edge cases over time. The end result is customers feel like Rima gets better and easier to use after every workflow. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101608&key=user_uploads/533018/eb9702ef-30bc-4604-ab86-033924c5b9f9)

\
Today, accountants use Rima to automate workflows such as cleanups and catchups, bank and CC recon and data entry for tax workpapers among others. 

Rima is best for accounting teams that still receive documents such as invoices, POs, statements and contracts via email attachments, scans or paper

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101608&key=user_uploads/533018/2d51ab0c-e331-4e20-926e-0c10dd86352f)


**_Our team_**

We worked closely with over 4000 small businesses while building a wholesale distribution business and our accounting back-office was a mess. We know how messy the data from SMB operations can be and understand the manual work their accountants go through to help these businesses thrive. 

Today accounting firms and in-house accounting teams are automating manual document workflows on Rima. 

**_Where we are headed_**

We’re on a mission to build the deepest edge case library, powering automations everywhere for SMB accounting teams.

launches.tagline: We're connecting the worlds largest parts distributors and manufacturers to retailers in Africa
launches.body:
Hello YC Family

This is Gana and Cedric, Co-founders at [Garage](https://www.garagemobility.com/).

**At Garage, we are building the wholesale marketplace for auto parts in Africa**

**Backstory**

Cedric and I are ex-founders with experience building, scaling and investing in startups in Africa. I used to buy and ship auto parts to my dad in Cameroon and realized that the landing cost once those parts arrived in Cameroon was still cheaper than buying locally. We realized that this issue was due to inefficiencies across the supply chain for parts distribution. Garage aims to solve this problem by building a wholesale marketplace that will power the $25B after sales market in Africa.

**The Problem**

Over $25B in auto parts sales in Africa occur at neighborhood retail shops. These retail shop owners are the backbone of the aftersales market yet they struggle to survive because

* They have no visibility into which suppliers have which parts
* Multiple layers of middle men and low buying power lead to inflated and volatile pricing
* They don’t have enough working capital to grow their businesses

**The Solution**

Garage is a wholesale auto parts distributor for Africa, supporting these retailers. We aggregate parts from the largest suppliers in the world and deliver directly to retailers. We are building the largest auto tech platform to reduce the cost of car ownership in Africa by making auto parts more affordable and accessible.

**TL;DR** Mogara automates capitalizing software R&D expenses (now required for all software companies filing taxes in the US).  Let’s talk if you do accounting at a software company with 30+ engineers and are responsible for R&D capitalization.

### **Problem**

The IRS made a change that impacts all software companies filing taxes in the US for the 2022 tax year and beyond: everyone needs to capitalize their software development costs.

For most accounting and engineering leaders, this is painful news: they’ll review projects over a quarter, determine what’s capitalizable based on the Internal Revenue Code, and send time tracking surveys for engineers to fill out on a quarterly basis. The time tracking surveys will need to be completed in order for accounting to close the books. 

Relying solely on issue trackers like Jira is not much better. Controllers say the fields they need aren’t reliably filled in, so they end up in a painful spiral of reminders - or falling back on time tracking surveys.

### **Solution**

Mogara automates software R&D capitalization. Every software company filing taxes in the US now needs to capitalize software R&D, representing a $13B opportunity for a process that’s currently manual reporting.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70141&key=user_uploads/881211/c0f0c07e-517d-4a9f-a100-afe1683c747a)

⚙️ Connect with issue tracking tools like Jira for easy categorization

💸 Tie in payroll data from your HRIS system to determine capitalizable costs for software development

🔢 Set up and track capitalizable projects with a simple wizard interface

### **How’d we get here?**

We’ve built simple user experiences for complex financial systems.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70141&key=user_uploads/881211/468ad4e6-2f34-4ec4-862d-f5f0ad664c5c)

Neha worked as a product manager at Affirm building traceability and reporting for the company’s multi-million dollar daily money movements. She saw how tough it could be for the accounting team to get the data they needed from software teams.

Jay worked at Stripe as a product engineer for nearly 5 years after getting acquired as an early engineer at a startup called Index, where he worked on several complex regulated fintech products.

We met through a mutual friend last year and hit it off. We share a love for good pizza, making memes of Jay’s kid, and music. Together, we have over a decade of product development experience and we’ve been at companies from the early stages all the way through preparing for IPO.

launches.body:
**TL;DR** Mulligan is an end to end AI automation platform for commercial insurance brokers. Cuts time spent on quoting, policy checking, proposals and more by 90%.\
Start for free at [usemulligan.com](http://usemulligan.com)

[Check out our launch video](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13cMUq8gAs5q-ZjXVqoS7SLv7pAC1ljYF/view?usp=sharing)!

# **Intro**

I’m Aman and we’re building Mulligan, the world’s first end-to-end AI automation platform for commercial insurance brokers. It automates Quoting, Policy Comparison, Proposals, Commissions and more. We work with dozens of brokers and have helped all of them scale their businesses without adding more employees.

# **Problem**

Selling and servicing commercial insurance is a complicated process to begin with, and the manual paperwork involved makes it difficult to scale profitably. Brokers have to spend hours reading lengthy documents, navigating ancient portals and formatting documents to fit into their internal systems.

Existing automation tools typically only address narrow workflows and do not integrate with each other, which means that automating a brokerage involves juggling multiple solutions and integrations.

The end result is that brokerages spend hundreds of hours every week, and billions of dollars annually, on non-revenue generating tasks and outsourcing.

# **Solution**

Mulligan assembles submissions, generates quotes from carrier portals, compares quotes and policies, generates proposals and handles commission statements in minutes, without needing your hands-on-keyboard. Here’s what it can do:

### **Quoting**

Quote from one of the largest selections of commercial lines insurance carriers for Commercial Auto, Workers’ Compensation, Business Owners’, General Liability and Trucking policies. Do so with minimal data entry and largely without human intervention. This makes it easy for an agent to get a more complete view of the market, do less data entry and spend more time with their customers.

To use it, select the carriers to quote, upload any documents that contain relevant data and click “Submit’’. Mulligan then logs into and produces draft quotes in each carrier portal, ready to review, edit and bind.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94819&key=user_uploads/1013488/6f26d394-1c38-4f97-a17e-99c397e184db)

### **Policy Checking & Comparison**

Analyze quotes, binders or policies, compare across documents and identify gaps in coverage. Manually analyzing these documents used to take hours, if not days, and can now be done in minutes. This tool can be used to service existing customers, as well as to help close new ones by analyzing their existing policies and identifying areas of improvement.

Simply upload docs, view them side-by-side, chat with them and match them to checklists to identify gaps.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94819&key=user_uploads/1013488/dbc87031-968d-4c02-8301-d77ee5cd94d3)

### **Proposals**

Generate beautiful, branded proposals using quotes, policies and binders in minutes. These documents can be produced in Mulligan’s own design format, or using a template provided by the agency. The end result is a document whose style, content and tone showcases the agency’s professionalism and thoroughness.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94819&key=user_uploads/1013488/f393c554-a4f4-4485-8d9a-9e89bfe6248e)

### **Submissions**

Produce clean, complete and professional submissions to send to underwriters. Upload diverse documents such as loss runs, SOVs, vehicle and driver lists, and produce easily ingestible documents with just a few clicks. These submissions help portray the customer in the best possible light, and get processed by underwriters faster since they are well organized and easy to process.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94819&key=user_uploads/1013488/66ba3d38-9f05-4ae9-a64f-fccefee61a2c)

### **Commissions**

Extract commissions from lengthy statements and transform them into a format expected by most popular Agency Management Systems such as Applied Epic, AMS360, EZLynx, Veruna and more. Furthermore, review the values in the commission statement to check if there’s an underpayment from the carrier, or to reconcile the books faster.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94819&key=user_uploads/1013488/218d7bc3-1aa4-45d6-abb8-0ddabd48c31f)

# **How to get started**

If you are an insurance agent working on commercial lines, or know someone who is, sign up at [usemulligan.com](http://usemulligan.com) for free and get started today. Mulligan has already been deployed across organizations of various sizes, and offers flexible pricing models that fit any budget.

launches.tagline: Frictionless Pay by Bank for LatAm!
launches.body:
**TLDR**

[Palomma](https://www.palomma.com/) helps online merchants and apps in LatAm save 70-80% on card processing fees and increase conversions, by enabling frictionless Pay by Bank for their customers (consumers and/or businesses).

**The problem**

1. Receiving card payments is expensive for merchants, it costs them between 2 to 5% per transaction
2. Receiving the cheaper alternative, Pay by Bank, poses several frictions:
   1. **Low conversion:** multiple steps are required to checkout via existing Pay by Bank solutions, resulting in a \~40% failure rate
   2. **Non-recurrent:** different from cards, existing Pay by Bank alternatives are hard to enable for recurring payments, requiring complex direct integrations with local banks
   3. **Confirmation:** confirming a bank payment requires checking bank accounts in real-time, or trusting the proof of confirmation sent by the customer (fraud-prone)
   4. **Reconciliation:** existing Pay by Bank data is cryptic: i.e., “68068407595”, making reconciliation difficult

**The solution:**

A single API and platform that allows online merchants or apps across LatAm (starting with Colombia) to receive frictionless Pay by Bank payments

1. **Higher conversion:** 30-40% more conversion with frictionless Pay by Bank
2. **Recurrent:** easily enable recurrent Pay by Bank payments
3. **Confirmation:** allow your employees to instantly confirm bank payments via our dashboard and WhatsApp / email notifications
4. **Easy reconciliation:** clearly identify each Pay by Bank payment in our dashboard

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70053&key=user_uploads/981886/c6212d2c-0c67-4542-a1d7-0e4973f1567d)

_PD: we´re also working on frictionless cash-out bank payments through our API & platform ;) 🔜_

**Why are we building this?**

During his time at Nubank, [Cipriano](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cipriano-echavarria-3729a9105/) personally saw the pain experienced by online merchants and apps with high card processing fees, and the friction around the cheaper, Pay by Bank alternatives.\
\
With [Pipe](https://www.linkedin.com/in/felipemon/) & [Nico](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ngomezdelcampo/)´s tech, we´re changing that 🕊️

launches.body:
TLDR: Numeral automates sales tax compliance for ecommerce stores. We do everything from registration to remittance.

### **Problem**:

In 2018, the [Supreme Court ruled](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Dakota_v._Wayfair,_Inc.) that states can require out-of-state merchants to charge sales tax.

This means Shopify stores are now required to register with up to 47 state agencies and potentially submit 47 monthly filings.

Additionally, there are over 13,000 local jurisdictions, each with their own complex set of rules and rates.

In Iowa, for example, Snickers bars are taxed, while Twix bars are tax-exempt because they contain flour. 🙄

The current solutions are confusing, self-serve products that offer little to no service.

### **Solution:**

Numeral automates the entire process for ecommerce sellers. Just connect your Shopify, Amazon, or other store and we handle the rest.

* Registration: We can register companies in all 47 sales tax charging states.
* Monitoring: We monitor for sales tax rate changes and automatically adjust your tax settings.
* Filing: Lastly, we submit tax returns & payments on your behalf.

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/xkilm56kCWPHeUyHBIY4a-dsuiEyZgxaIoWV0bcsxo-WXl3fZxZ2qWf5D3I6xy0at4xZ8gvmkxmM245gEWXLIil-WFtvKERRMZmy22bsNB4A95owzOuA7mY1MC3FwQLB9A1gRsqPiG9o85HRpybvCaI)

### **Why us?**

**Sam** - Sam ran his own bootstrapped e-commerce studio that generated over $50M in revenue over the last 4 years. He previously worked in growth & product roles at Airbnb (W09) and Teespring (W13).

**_TL;DR:_** _Benchmark is the fastest way to screen deals & analyze investment data. Benchmark efficiently extracts, organizes, and summarizes key information from any data source in seconds while automatically building a proprietary comp database. With Benchmark, decision-makers can capitalize on opportunities with unmatched speed and precision. Visit _[_https://withbenchmark.com_](https://withbenchmark.com)_ to accelerate your investment process today._

_—_

Hey YC! We are Alec, Connor, and Josh, the co-founders of Benchmark. We are on a mission to change how private market investors screen investment opportunities and utilize data.

### **❌ The Problem:**

Investment teams spend thousands of hours each year reviewing investment opportunities that die. When deals die, all of the precious data and context that was painstakingly collected is lost in old email chains and folders. This data is a gold mine for investment firms but is currently neglected. As a result, investment teams spend way too much time focusing on low-probability opportunities, digging through old files for comps, and redoing old analyses.

### **✅ Our Solution:**

Benchmark automatically extracts, normalizes, and summarizes deal data from any data source. Allowing investment teams to quickly screen deals, answer due diligence questions, build comps, and gather context. Benchmark’s single source of truth for deal data provides a huge competitive advantage for teams by minimizing the amount of time they spend on low-probability deals and building permanent institutional knowledge.

### **❓ How it Works:**

* **Upload deal documents**
  * Documents from any data source, whether internal or external, are securely parsed in minutes
* **Instantly screen your deal**
  * Review deal summaries, key metrics, internal comps, due diligence question answers, and highlighted risks
* **Dive deeper into any area of interest with Q&A**
  * Ask any question about the deal, and Benchmark will provide accurate answers with instantly verifiable sources, reasoning, and citations.
* **Retain and analyze all of your data**
  * Upon upload, each file has key metrics extracted - transforming previously unstructured data into a structured database ready for any analysis

launches.body:
### **Tl;dr**:

BidSight makes it easy for commercial real estate (CRE) development teams to manage and collaborate on complex pre-construction workflows. Today, CRE developers manually track pre-construction workflows across hundreds of project documents, which leads to extremely costly errors. BidSight’s platform acts as a single source of truth for development teams, eliminating errors and saving them millions. [Learn more today!](https://www.bidsight.io/)

Hi everyone! We’re Alec, Connor, and Josh from [BidSight](https://www.bidsight.io/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=68929&key=user_uploads/1122874/e2f756ee-d963-4a1b-b098-b60906f34233)

### **🚧 The Problem: The Pre-Construction process is broken**

During pre-construction, commercial real estate developers rely on numerous stakeholders (architects, engineers, contractors, etc.) to help design, permit, and plan construction projects within their budget. However, development teams currently have to utilize a patchwork of non-specialized tools (email, excel, PDF editors, etc) to manage stakeholder workflows and output, creating error-prone, non-standardized, and siloed processes.

The current process forces development teams to recreate the wheel from scratch on every project and causes them to lose millions of dollars on each project due to error driven delays.

### 📖**Background**

launches.tagline: Motörhead is an open-source memory and information retrieval server for LLMs.
launches.body:
## Overview

[Motörhead](https://github.com/getmetal/motorhead) is an open-source memory and information retrieval server for LLMs. Built and supported by [Metal](https://getmetal.io/).

As LLM usage becomes more widely adopted, modern software products must handle users' LLM interactions, chat sessions, and retrieval for relevant prompting context at scale. With much of the performance cost being on the prompting to APIs like OpenAI and other LLMs, contextual data retrieval is ideally as fast as possible.

## Features

* 🪄 Modern strategies to stay within the prompt window
* 💬 Chat session management out of the box
* 🦜 [Langchain integration](https://python.langchain.com/en/latest/modules/memory/examples/motorhead_memory.html)
* 🧠 Automatic Embedding generation via OpenAI ADA
* 🕸️ Redis Vector DB forto utilize RedisSearch (semantic)
* 💽 Short-term & long-term storage
* 🔥 Built in Rust for performance

## Roadmap

* User Authentication
* Knowledge Graph Memory handling
* Additional support for other Embedding Models
* [Create an issue!](https://github.com/getmetal/motorhead/issues)

## Resources

* Check out [Motörhead on Github](https://github.com/getmetal/motorhead)
* Join the [Motörhead Discord](https://discord.gg/sxbFX5dsQY)
* Suggest a [feature for Motörhead](https://github.com/getmetal/motorhead/issues)

launches.title: Metal: Helping developers easily implement machine learning embeddings

launches.body:
tl;dr

_Metal makes it easy for developers to implement machine learning embeddings. With embeddings, we help businesses create value from unstructured data like images, text documents, videos and more._

Hey everyone! We’re Taylor, James, and Sergio and we’re building [Metal.](https://www.getmetal.io/?utm_campaign=pre-launch&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=YC)

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/BAmRW6DjuFBKZwKTqlBZ3usUOyMeRtO_c34yip0WO65CQX-VCS3IeNXKPOE57AdV-HApI_CC0QjqVgurwEDxHJSDo9BxV5Pve7VXz20yulLPBNYbSKHQXqSxhLowmbYOUlQ7c3sln6lJ4eRTuVMRmL0)

**What’s the problem?**

Embeddings are super powerful but they’re too hard to use. We learned this the hard way while building machine learning products at companies like Spotify and Meta. Getting to production for simple features (or so we thought) was incredibly painful.

The team would put weeks into offline training only for the data to be stale in production. It was difficult to iterate on models without versioning. Fine-tuning was highly inefficient. When we finally did get a model deployed there were immediate scaling concerns. It once took us 6 frustrating months to ship a simple embedding classification feature 🤦

Companies shouldn’t need to reinvent the wheel to use embeddings.

**What’s the solution?**

Metal gives you all the tools you need to quickly and easily implement embeddings against your data in production. 

* We integrate with your data sources
* We generate and store your embeddings
* We provide real time indexing and search APIs
* We provide versioning
* And we make it easier to fine tune embeddings via Metal’s API or SDKs

You can get started in as little as five minutes.

![](https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/izlgcDfSdm-FgMwj8Cns-nsnN2GmkAuUtdsSCQKuLawBY0fcv3KZjgkjiwxa7yiOpbPOnNZs_uN9ERNmCS8ZVVP3IC-NY-qHBe1cuipof9D7JKskIn6FvN-BSuYULjJGJPb6xYyi3e47OUDZ2qm9c4U)

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/nOmwv8oD-qYgxa_m6enimIFMTirXP1olznsJv1UrojbT2lf69WdR0vxc2xLkX8TceIfAusPKPFopsM2vjXcGXIJMDMHQz9lgJhmxPr2qcOI3uS5_b7LI44k1HvaYeFSF2uGvHp1fpgMzuqVsU31sNaA)

**Ok so it’s easy to use, but what about some real world use cases?**

* Better personalization for your users through behavioral clustering
* Search and compare similarities between data types, such as images or videos
* Understand how your customers feel by classifying their free text reviews
* Make the most of internal resources by supporting semantic search of text documents, PDFs, call notes and more

**Our ask:**

1. [**Sign up for early access**](https://www.getmetal.io/?utm_campaign=pre-launch&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=YC) and we will get in touch! [You can also book a time here to learn more](https://calendly.com/metal-taylor/metal-30-minutes-landing?utm_campaign=pre-launch&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=YC).
2. **Introduce us to companies** who could use Metal. We mostly work with small to medium size companies (10-200 people) who have raised a series A. These companies have an embeddings use case but don’t want to spend the time/resources to build it from scratch.
3. **Help us build the future** :) If you’re experienced with embeddings and want them to be simpler, then we’d love to hear from you. Please get in touch: [founders@getmetal.io](mailto:founders@getmetal.io)

You can also follow us on [Twitter](https://x.com/metal__ai) or [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/company/getmetal?utm_campaign=pre-launch&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_source=YC) :) 🤘

launches.body:
```
Introduction
```

Accend for Banking is AI infrastructure that helps banks turn financial documents into structured financial models and credit insights — from hours to minutes.

Built for commercial banks and CRE lenders, it sits inside existing credit workflows and removes the most manual parts of underwriting, so banks can move faster and win more deals.

<https://youtu.be/ZZZYw-Q0XLQ>

---

```
The Problem
```

Credit underwriting in banks is slow because it still relies on legacy systems and outdated tools that haven’t evolved in decades.

Across most banks today:

* Financial documents are collected across emails, portals, and shared drives
* Borrowers upload tax returns, financials, and supporting documents across fragmented systems
* Data is manually extracted and spread into Excel
* Financial models are rebuilt repeatedly for each case
* Credit memos are written from scratch every time
* Monitoring and covenant tracking happen separately

These workflows are:

* Fragmented across systems
* Manual and time-intensive
* Difficult to scale without adding headcount
* Prone to inconsistencies and errors

Even as lending demand has increased, the infrastructure supporting underwriting has remained largely unchanged for decades.

---

```
What This Means for Banks
```

The impact of these workflows goes beyond operations — it directly affects people, speed, and business outcomes.

* Analysts spend hours on data preparation instead of credit decisions
* Turnaround times slow down lending and delay decisions
* Banks lose deals to faster competitors
* Productivity is lost across the workflow due to repeated manual effort
* Scaling requires adding headcount instead of improving systems

At a time when speed matters more than ever, these constraints make it harder for banks to compete.

---

```
How Accend Helps
```

Accend brings these fragmented steps into a single, structured workflow.

With Accend:

* Borrowers upload tax and financial documents through a single secure link or connect their accounting systems
* Automated requests and reminders keep document collection moving
* Financial documents are parsed into structured, audit-ready data in minutes
* Detailed schedules and supporting statements are captured with high accuracy
* Property-level data (e.g., Schedule E, Form 8825) is broken down with full visibility
* Cash flow models are generated instantly and mapped consistently
* Credit insights and memos are built on top of structured data

This means:

* Analysts spend time on credit decisions, not data preparation
* Turnaround times shrink from hours to minutes
* Teams can handle more volume without increasing headcount
* Outputs remain consistent across deals

---

```
How Accend Works
```

Accend integrates into your existing credit workflow and processes each case end-to-end:

**1. Document Intake**

Send a secure link to borrowers to upload tax and financial documents, or connect directly to accounting systems. Automated requests and reminders ensure completeness.

**2. Data Extraction & Structuring**

Accend parses full tax packages in minutes — including 1040s, 1065s, 1120s, 1120-S, and supporting schedules — and converts them into structured, audit-ready data with source traceability.

**3. Detailed Financial Spreading**

Financials are standardized across income statements, balance sheets, and cash flows. Supporting statements and add-backs are surfaced automatically.

**4. Modeling & Analysis**

Data maps instantly into cash flow models. Teams can drill into sources, override values, run ratios, and leave notes — with every change tracked.

**5. Configurable Financial Models**

Models are configured to your bank’s policies — personal, business, global — ensuring consistency across teams while supporting complex analysis.

**6. Monitoring & Covenant Tracking**

Once underwriting is complete, covenants are tracked automatically with scheduled tests, due dates, and alerts.

---

```
Get Started
```

If you work in credit, underwriting, risk, or lending operations, Accend helps you modernize your workflow without replacing your systems.

[Schedule a call with Pranjal](https://calendly.com/pranjal-accend/30min), our co-founder, to learn more.

Or explore Accend for Banking → <https://www.withaccend.com/banking>

Today we’re launching **Accend 2.0** — our most ambitious release yet, designed to help financial institutions modernize how they **collect**, **spread**, and **analyze** financial data for underwriting.

Our goal is simple: make underwriting radically faster, more accurate, and effortless for credit teams at banks and fintechs.

https://youtu.be/YT6u7ahsSJE

```
🧨 The Problem
```

Underwriting commercial credit still relies on slow, manual workflows — especially when it comes to handling borrower financials.

Credit teams spend days:

* Chasing borrowers for PDFs, Excel files, and accounting access
* Manually spreading financials into internal formats
* Creating credit memos from scratch
* Spotting anomalies by gut feel or Excel checks

This workflow is not just inefficient — it introduces real risk. Missed red flags, errors in classification, or simply moving too slowly can result in bad loans or lost deals.

```
🧑‍💻 Who Faces This Problem?
```

This problem is felt most acutely by:

* **Fintech lenders** scaling underwriting ops
* **Banks modernizing** legacy credit infrastructure
* **Credit risk and underwriting teams** who are overloaded and under-automated

```
💡 Our Solution: Accend 2.0
```

With Accend 2.0, lenders get a single platform to do the following:

## **1. Frictionless Financial Data Collection with Accend Link**

Collecting financials from borrowers is where friction often begins. That’s why we’re launching **Accend Link** — a borrower-facing portal that streamlines data collection from day one.

Borrowers can:

* **Link accounting software directly** — like QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite
* **Or simply upload financials manually** — PDFs, Excel, whatever works for them

🧘‍♂️ No more chasing documents.\
🔄 No more back-and-forth.\
📁 Just clean, accurate data — in the format you need.

---

## **2. Deep, Accurate, and Customizable Financial Spreading**

Once the data is in, Accend gets to work.

* **AI-powered line-item classification**
* **Ratio calculation and benchmarking** against industry standards
* **Full analyst control** — reclassify line items on the fly and build custom ratios tailored to your credit policy

📋 No spreadsheets. No version control nightmares. Just clarity.

---

## **3. Next-Gen Credit Memos, Built in Minutes**

This is where Accend 2.0 truly shines.

We automatically generate **credit memos** that combine:

* 📄 **Business model summaries**
* 📰 **Real-time financial news**
* 📊 **Financial health analysis** powered by ratio performance

It's like having your smartest analyst prepare every memo — in minutes, not days.

Your team gets faster turnaround times and deeper insights — without lifting a finger.

---

## **4. Proactively Flag Risk with Case Signals**

We’re also launching **Case Signals**, a feature that catches issues before they become problems.

With over a dozen automated checks — including:

* Reconciliation mismatches
* Volatility spikes
* Abnormal ratio patterns

Accend flags anomalies the moment they appear — so your team can act fast and stay ahead of credit risk.


launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Accend accelerates manual reviews and automatically generates regulatory reports for Ops & Compliance teams.

B2B Fintechs and BaaS providers utilize Accend to save hours per manual process, such as KYB applications, Disputes, Transaction Monitoring, etc. 

If you work in **Ops & Compliance at fintechs, we’d love to chat with you**. Please reach out at [**founders@withaccend.com**](mailto:founders@withaccend.com)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73980&key=user_uploads/225420/7582fece-a662-4123-b052-645eadcf2166)

```
How we know this is a problem?
```

When we led Product & Engineering on Risk at Brex, we collaborated with Ops & Compliance teams on a daily basis. For Ops, one of the biggest pain points was declining Ops efficiency + quality of output. For Compliance, it was maintaining healthy relationships with banking partners and regulators. The reasons behind that were:

1. **Complex Processes:** Expanding customer base led to complex reviews due to diverse profiles and services, complicating the process. Moreover, manual reviews are prone to errors and inefficiencies due to overwhelming data verification tasks.
2. **Regulatory Compliance Burden:** Adhering to changing regulations in compliance (esp in KYC) required meticulous attention to detail, slowing down reviews.
3. **Scaling via Outsourced Ops Teams:** We noticed a skills gap in outsourced teams regarding regulations and fintech processes, impacting review quality. Training them for consistency took significant time and investment.
4. **Time-Consuming Regulatory Reports:** Creating detailed regulatory reports like Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) demanded significant time, complicated by language and cultural challenges, subsequently influencing the clarity and level of detail.

This posed 

1. **Business Risk** - suboptimal customer experience at the time of onboarding and worse, rejection of a legitimate customer, thereby losing revenue. 
2. **Compliance Risk** - hefty penalties (eg: Coinbase’s $100M fine), legal consequences, significant damage to the company's reputation, and even the potential loss of banking partnerships (existential crisis alert!).

We realized _Brex wasn’t the only fintech dealing with such risks tied to manual reviews_, and we started Accend to tackle these challenges head-on.

```
Our Solution 
```

Our first use case is accelerating KYB manual reviews. It includes the following features:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73980&key=user_uploads/225420/324bc297-c392-4209-af77-19146a90b3e3)

**Guided Review Workflow:** Accend simplifies the KYC procedure by converting the Standard Operating Procedure into a user-friendly, step-by-step guided review process for both internal and external Operations professionals.

**Streamlined Online Research:** Instead of juggling numerous browser tabs to validate information about the business and its beneficial owners/controllers, Accend consolidates data through comprehensive web searches, presenting a summary for validation by Ops professionals.

**Automated Due Diligence Reports:** Traditionally, crafting a CDD/EDD report can take up to 2 hours. Accend automates this process, generating high-quality narrative reports in the company's required template, thus saving valuable Operations time on a daily basis.

**Audit Logs:** Accend establishes an audit trail for actions taken by Operations professionals and the automated processes during KYC manual reviews. This eliminates the need to scour various sources, extract logs, and document them, streamlining the auditing process

```
Why Accend?
```

With Accend, Fintechs can

* Improve Ops’ quality of output with consistent procedures
* Increase Ops’ efficiency with automation
* Reduce cost in managing Ops teams 
* Maintain healthy relationships with banking partners and regulators

```
Who are we?
```

[Pranjal Daga](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranjaldaga/) was most recently the Product Manager on the Risk team at Brex where he reduced fraud losses by $20M and worked on disputes, declines, login friction, etc. Before that, he dropped out of his PhD in AI/ML at Purdue University to help set up Cisco Innovation Labs where he grew the team from 1 to 35 in 4 years.

[Yutong Pei](https://www.linkedin.com/in/yutong-pei-81006842/) was most recently the Engineering Manager on the Fraud Risk team at Brex where he built the Disputes service, and worked on fraud controls by managing engineers and data scientists. Previously, he has led Fraud Engineering and Security for IoTeX, Uber, and Amazon. 

[Joseph Zhou](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joseph-tianshi-zhou/) was most recently the CFO of a mobile gaming startup based in Singapore with a 50M ARR. He established the company’s licensed poker operation in Europe and scaled the team from 0 to 80 members, while also managing KYC, AML, compliance, responsible gaming, and fraud prevention.

```
Our ask
```

We’re looking to connect with Ops & Compliance leaders at B2B Fintechs and BaaS providers to explore how Accend can help them improve Ops efficiency & quality and excel on compliance.

```
Launch YC Promo
```

launches.body:
Watch our launch video [here](https://youtu.be/NFJvgmm4lIs).

**tl;dr**: _Banks, credit unions, and fintechs spend billions to train and employ staff to handle complex systems and ever-growing service portfolios. Our AI agents make your teams 10x faster by navigating existing systems, surfacing the right information, and even communicating compliantly with your customers._

### **🏆THE TEAM**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73899&key=user_uploads/1361486/1a6a8344-6014-46dd-81da-a861bd539b7e)

**Lukas Haffer** **(CEO, Stanford GSB 23)** spent the past 4 years deploying core banking systems and outsourcing banking processes as Chief of Staff for Europe at Avaloq (one of the world’s leading core banking system providers).

**Isaiah Williams (CTO, Stanford CS 22)** spent the past 4 years building conversational AI and production ML applications as a Senior ML engineer at EliseAI (one of the world’s leading conversational AI companies).

### 

### **WHAT CAN AI DO FOR BANKING?**

**Lending & Onboarding**: 300,000+ loan officers spend hours on the phone or e-mail getting applicants to complete their applications before they churn to competitors - our AI agent Leo does not give up until he has all the documents he needs.

> Even if we pre-qualify more applicants, we don’t close more loans - because my loan officers can only have one conversation at a time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73899&key=user_uploads/1361486/3b366876-5474-45ab-ba82-ffd1d6a6d59b)

**Customer service**: 30,000+ daily service requests present an insane challenge to the staff of a mid-sized bank, trying to navigate multiple outdated systems and product categories - our AI agent Tom navigates their systems, surfaces the right information, and drafts responses to your clients.

> Customer support has become an insane job - my teams need to navigate 15 different systems just to help 1 customer.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73899&key=user_uploads/1361486/4cc6b719-7ac1-4321-95d1-e88f98d160d0)

**Back-office**: at one bank 50,000+ payments are halted every day for reasons as simple as a typo in the recipient account ID - our AI agent Anna analyzes unstructured financial information to recommend resolutions.

> Even with 99% STP-rates (straight through processing) in payments, we have to manually handle thousands of exceptions.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73899&key=user_uploads/1361486/c4385ccb-a65f-4e51-9c54-0f7b8ca54a54)

### **❌ THE PROBLEM**

Antiquated systems and manual exception handling slow down crucial banking processes, costing banks billions. Traditional robotic process automation (RPA) could not handle unstructured information. Traditional chatbots quickly reach their limits of usefulness. And custom ML applications take months (if not years) to develop from scratch.

### **✅ OUR SOLUTION**

_Cascading AI agents integrate with the bank's existing IT infrastructure (in their private cloud or on-premise), learn to use their systems, and work with unstructured financial data to automate core processes._

### **HOW IT WORKS**

1. **Our Agents have eyes**: we use computer vision to read documents & integrate with existing systems on a UI level in addition to your APIs
2. **Our Agents can talk**: we use conversational AI to communicate with customers or colleagues via SMS, E-Mail, Slack, Teams, secure messaging, or ticket management systems
3. **Our Agents know banking**: we monitor agents in human-in-the-loop systems and align them with banking regulation and compliance policies

### **OUR ASK**

* Connect us with Banks, Credit Unions, or Fintechs looking to automate manual processes and improve customer communication.
* Book a [demo](https://calendly.com/lhaffer/30-min-meeting?month=2023-08) or email us at [lukas@cascading.ai](mailto:lukas@cascading.ai)
* Follow Cascading AI on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/cascading-ai)

**VectorShift Platform**

Through drag-and-drop components, VectorShift’s no-code builder allows you to: 

* Use a flexible “visual programming language” to prototype, build, deploy, and manage LLM apps.

* Place interfaces on workflows that you build (e.g., chat, forms, search engine, bulk runs, voice, etc.).
* Maintain enterprise-grade security - VectorShift is SOC2 Type 2, GDPR, and HIPPA compliant.

 

**Enterprise Search Product Launch**

launches.title: 💥 Cedalio — A blockchain empowered alternative to Firebase
launches.tagline: Build apps with data that is auditable and verifiable by default
launches.body:
[Cedalio](https://www.cedalio.com) is a platform that helps you build apps with information that is auditable by default. Data used in your application can be traced back to its origin for verification. Even more, with us you can give your users real ownership and portability of their data across different applications.

## 📚 **TL;DR**

* Cedalio provides companies with the tools to build trust and accountability by offering transparent, auditable data.
* With Cedalio, organizations prioritizing user privacy can empower users with true ownership of their data, promoting its portability across various applications.
* By storing access control information on-chain, Cedalio ensures a censorship-resistant database, safeguarding information integrity.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72841&key=user_uploads/1337055/6fdf4c1c-3f4b-474e-89b1-66ff7ef1d6ce)

**_Interested? →_** Get started now at [**www.cedalio.com**](http://www.cedalio.com)\
**Do you have a new use case in mind? →** Let us know on our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/kSdhmb9UUT)\
**_Do you want how it works under the hood? →_** Read our [**DocSite**](https://docs.cedalio.com/introduction/about-cedalio)

## 👩‍💻 **How do we do it:**

* **Verifiable data:** field-level certifications offers a means to validate the data's integrity, creating trust and assurance in the accuracy of the information.
* **On chain access controls**: the access control rules are stored in a smart contract, ensuring a censorship-resistant database.
* **On chain log:** by recording a detailed log of transactions on the blockchain, we enable auditability and the ability to reconstruct the database if needed.

Hey YC! We’re the CatX team, and we are excited to announce the launch of [Catamaran 2.0](https://trycatamaran.com/)—the smartest way to analyze natural catastrophe risks for any property, location, or business.

🔍 **Problem**

Organizations today struggle with outdated, slow, and expensive processes for assessing natural catastrophe risks. Traditional tools lack comprehensive insights, require significant manual effort, and leave critical gaps in understanding how disasters like wildfires, hurricanes, earthquakes, and severe weather could impact their assets and portfolios.

💡 **Our Solution**

Catamaran makes catastrophe risk analysis effortless and powerful. Just upload your property details or any relevant documents, and Catamaran instantly generates comprehensive risk insights using extensive historical data across all major catastrophe perils—including wildfires, hurricanes, earthquakes, typhoons, weather, hail and more.

<https://youtu.be/s4mTqmcFsWY>

Powered by advanced AI agents, Catamaran quickly identifies errors, provides clarity from complex datasets, and delivers insights previously only available through costly, manual underwriting.

We spent the past two years helping institutional investors understand, model, and invest in catastrophic risk. Frustrated by outdated workflows in underwriting and risk assessment amidst modernizing processes everywhere else, we built Catamaran as our solution.

⚡ **What Catamaran Can Do:**

* 📚 **Historical Risk Analysis:** Evaluate location-specific risk profiles based on hundreds of years of historical data.
* 🛡️ **Optimal Insurance Protection:** Automatically identify the best insurance structures—parametric or traditional—tailored to your unique risk exposure.
* 📄 **Advanced Document Extraction:** Effortlessly process complex, unstructured documents to rapidly extract key insights.
* 📈 **Calculate Loss & Scenario Analysis:** Instantly conduct sophisticated scenario analyses to quantify potential losses for proactive risk management.

launches.title: CatX - the digital marketplace for insurance risk
launches.tagline: We are the best way for insurance companies to offload risk and for asset managers to invest in an attractive, uncorrelated asset class.
launches.body:
CatX is a digital marketplace connecting insurance carriers with institutional investors to trade and transfer insurance risk efficiently. We help to make insurance risk models understandable and accessible for asset managers so they can unlock new sources of return. In addition, we streamline and digitalize the entire risk transfer process, so insurers can get faster, cheaper access to capital from our partner funds.

**❌ The Problems:**

1. **Rising hedging and funding costs for insurers,** US property rates are up 265% over a six-year period
2. **Highly inefficient risk transfer markets,** with average cost ratios of 40% remaining largely unchanged despite recent technological advancements
3. **Slow and expensive set-up and structuring processes** when issuing new insurance-linked products, involving multiple parties
4. **Little secondary market liquidity for insurance-linked securities** due to their complex economics and limited availability of risk models
5. **Poor analytics or data-drive insights** for understanding novel areas of risks

**💡Our Solution**

CatX addresses these challenges by simplifying the market and providing access to world’s most advanced modeling technologies directly within our platform. In addition, we streamline the origination process, including legal setup and pricing, and offer an electronic secondary trading venue coupled with sophisticated analytics.

CatX helps:

* **Insurers** to access capital at **better rates** through direct capital markets access,
* **Investors** to unlock new investment opportunities in an uncorrelated asset class,
* **Protection buyers** find more efficient structures to offload risks, reducing the protection gap for novel and emerging risks.

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72510&key=user_uploads/1360323/ca917659-8d2c-4371-a236-a1fc95a58903)


**🙏Our Ask**

Connect us with

* **Investors** interested in accessing new sources of uncorrelated returns,
* **(Re)insurers** looking for access to more flexible capital at better rates,
* **Businesses** looking to more efficiently transfer risks (property, weather, energy, cyber)
* **Risk model providers** seeking new distribution opportunities.

**✉️ Contact**

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to [Ben](https://www.linkedin.com/in/benedict-altier-0041748b/) or [Lucas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/lucas-sch/) directly or email [founders@catxglobal.com](mailto:founders@catxglobal.com).

launches.title: Goldbridge – Ramp for Real Estate 🏠
launches.tagline: The all-in-one financial platform for real estate owners. Banking + intelligence + automation, custom-built for property owners & operators.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** We can increase a real estate owner’s property values by 20 percent in less than three months. We already have thousands of units on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of 8M units in 2026.

We’re [Alvin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alvinsalehi/) & [Greg](https://www.linkedin.com/in/gregrami/) and we’re the founders of [Goldbridge](https://www.goldbridgebanking.com/). Alvin’s first YC company, Shef (W19), is a homemade food marketplace that helped change state laws across the country so that people could legally cook and sell food from home. They raised over $100M, scaled Shef nationally, and built it into a Series B company that continues to grow rapidly across the country.

Now we’re building Goldbridge, the financial operating system for real estate – and we built it from the ground up based on our personal experience owning and operating residential properties.

**THE PROBLEM**

Over **$1 trillion** **of rent** flows through landlords’ bank accounts every year, and nearly 25% of it sits idle in reserves and deposits. In other words, **real estate banking is fundamentally broken**:

* Traditional banks don’t understand real estate cashflows
* Property management systems don’t handle money movement, treasury, or yield
* Operators juggle multiple bank accounts, spreadsheets, and manual reconciliations
* Billions are lost every year in missed yield, overpayments, and operational inefficiencies

This is one of the largest underserved financial categories in the country.

**WHY WE BUILT GOLDBRIDGE**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/286eb9a4-254e-43a5-b09c-1e451fbb85ce)

As the son of immigrants, Alvin grew up in a motel and helped his parents manage properties growing up. Now he owns 81 units in the Bay Area, and he’s personally experienced how painful it is to manage property finances once you hit mid-market scale (50+ units).

By modernizing his banking stack, renegotiating contracts, appealing his property tax bills, applying for government rebates, optimizing maintenance spend, and restructuring rent collections, Alvin took his 81-unit portfolio from **–2% burn → +36% cashflow in just a few months.**

We’ve now replicated this for other property owners, and the patterns are universal.

**OUR SOLUTION**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95598&key=user_uploads/95578/de43ac4b-4268-4af9-8522-7410002f340c)

**1. Banking Built for Real Estate**

High yield operating accounts, reserve accounts, and automated reconciliations across your entire portfolio of properties -- all under one FDIC-backed infrastructure.

**2. Automated Savings & Earnings Optimization**

Goldbridge automatically surfaces:

* Property-tax reassessment opportunities
* Vendor contract renegotiation opportunities
* Government rebate and incentive programs
* Utility bill errors
* Idle cash yield optimization
* Reserve allocation improvements

Because Goldbridge sits at the **banking + transaction layer**, we have access to data that is cleaner, richer, and more accurate than generic financial platforms. On top of that, we can actually move money for owners intelligently and safely rather than just highlighting the issues that need to be resolved and throwing the manual work back onto their plates.

**WHY NOW**

**1. A $2.5T Refi Wall Is Coming (2027–2028)**

An estimated $2.5 trillion in real estate loans will mature soon, which is making owners desperate to improve their property finances. They will need pristine financials, liquidity discipline, and real-time visibility into how their money moves.

**2. LLMs Unlock Automation in a Data-Dense Industry**

Needless to say, real estate produces massive amounts of invoices, leases, utility bills, tax docs, contracts, rent rolls, and loan agreements. What previously took days to review and reconcile can now be done in minutes.

**TRACTION**

We’re moving extremely fast. We already have **thousands of units** on board and just signed a strategic partnership deal with a company that puts us in front of **8M units** in 2026.

**FOUNDERS**

**Alvin Salehi (Co-Founder/CEO)**

* 2x YC founder
* Multifamily owner/operator (100+ units)
* Co-founder of [Shef](https://shef.com/) (Series B)
* Fmr Senior Tech Advisor @ White House

**Greg Rami (Co-Founder/CTO)**

* 15+ yrs eng experience with Data/ML/SWE; full stack + mobile native
* Built parallel data processing for physics models @ NIST
* Led engineering teams at high-growth companies

**GET IN TOUCH**

Goldbridge is building the financial OS for a trillion-dollar vertical. Drop us a line anytime if you’d like to chat – [**founders@goldbridgebanking.com**](mailto:founders@goldbridgebanking.com).

launches.title: R2R: Open-Source Agentic Retrieval System with Deep Research API
launches.tagline: Enterprise-grade Deep Research API for Your Data plus the Web
launches.body:
### TL;DR

**R2R** is an open-source system that extends beyond conventional RAG by adding autonomous research capabilities across your documents and the web. After processing large document collections in production environments, we developed the Deep Research API to help applications better connect and synthesize information from multiple sources. R2R is available as both a cloud service and self-hostable solution.

**Cloud App Signup:** [app.sciphi.ai](http://app.sciphi.ai) (generous free tier, no credit card required)\
**GitHub:** [R2R](https://github.com/SciPhi-AI/R2R)

### Demo

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88711&key=user_uploads/372342/15328b62-f902-4d58-b559-8360b3468618)

### The Problem

Traditional RAG systems have fundamental limitations:

* They match queries to documents but lack multi-step reasoning
* Complex questions require manual investigation across multiple sources
* Information synthesis remains a largely human task
* Citation tracking and verification are often missing
* The reasoning process remains opaque

These limitations create inefficiencies when dealing with complex information needs.

---

### Our Solution

The Deep Research API provides:

* Multi-step reasoning across documents and web sources
* Knowledge graph generation to establish connections between information
* Chained research workflows for exploring complex topics
* Citation-backed answers with source attribution
* Real-time visibility into the agent's thinking process
* RESTful endpoints for straightforward integration

---

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88711&key=user_uploads/372342/9d86d7c9-d1df-4d47-a3ad-b126b12c3941)

---

# **Key Features**

**Research Capabilities**

* Research Agent: Advanced reasoning with computational tools
* Extended Thinking: Configurable reasoning depth with model support
* Citation Tracking: Source attribution for verification

**Platform Components**

* Multimodal Ingestion: Support for .txt, .pdf, .json, .png, .mp3, and more
* Hybrid Search: Semantic and keyword search with reciprocal rank fusion
* Knowledge Graphs: Entity and relationship extraction
* User/Document Management: Authentication and collection organization

### Why Now?

LLMs are evolving toward better reasoning, but simply uploading all data to models is costly and error-prone. Agentic RAG solves the "when/what to retrieve" challenge, ensuring LLMs access the right information, especially for enterprise applications with diverse data. Teams need less DevOps and faster market entry without debugging embeddings or managing infrastructure.

---

### Our Ask

Are you building advanced AI solutions that demand deeper reasoning over your own data? Tired of kludging multiple services together?

* **Sign up** at [app.sciphi.ai](http://app.sciphi.ai) (free tier included).
* **Dive into repo** on [Github](https://github.com/SciPhi-AI/R2R)
* **Book an exploratory call** [here](https://calendly.com/owen-uzg/sciphi-demo)

---

### About Us

We’re a team of AI veterans who contributed heavily to the open-source R2R project. Seeing how complicated “truly agentic” retrieval can be, we launched **SciPhi Cloud**—so you can enjoy advanced retrieval and multi-step reasoning at scale without the infrastructure burden.
