launches.body:
**TL;DR**: [SciPhi](https://www.sciphi.ai/) is a **cloud platform** that simplifies the deployment and optimization of production-ready Retrieval-Augmented Generation (**RAG**) pipelines for developers. Built on top of the robust **open source** **R2R** framework, SciPhi enables builders to focus on creating innovative applications rather than managing infrastructure.

[**SciPhi Cloud Demo**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ANWAGCzGQUU&ab_channel=redfauna101)

**The Problem**

RAG is fundamentally a search problem, and search at scale is hard. While deploying a basic RAG pipeline is relatively straightforward, scaling it to meet the diverse needs of a growing user base and/or dataset presents significant challenges. As indexed data grows, query times can slow down, leading to a diminished user experience. Further, different users will have varying complaints about system performance, depending on their specific use case and data set.

**📦 SciPhi's Solution**

* Seamless deployment of RAG pipelines to the cloud in just a few clicks
* Customizable configurations via an intuitive config.json file to specify vector DB, embedding settings, LLMs, etc.
* Secure secret management to encrypt and store API keys and other sensitive info
* Automatic scaling to handle increased traffic and data volumes as your app grows
* Built-in monitoring, logging, and A/B testing to gain insights and optimize performance ￼

SciPhi was founded by [Owen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/owencolegrove/) (CEO), who brings a unique perspective to the world of RAG. We're on a mission to empower developers to build state-of-the-art RAG pipelines. If that resonates, come build the future with us! Reach out to [founders@sciphi.ai](mailto:founders@sciphi.ai) to chat.

launches.body:
Hi YC! We're Jude & Daniel, and we’ve built Carousel - an AI assistant that transforms how people work in Excel.

# **The Problem: Excel is Powerful but Painful**

Excel remains the universal language of business despite being:

* **Time-consuming**: Building models takes hours of manual work
* **Error-prone**: Manual data entry and complex formulas lead to mistakes
* **Intimidating**: Mastering Excel formulas takes years

Professionals spend countless hours battling spreadsheets instead of focusing on decision-making.

# **Our Solution: Your Personal Excel Intern**

Carousel is an AI assistant that builds spreadsheets & models in minutes, not hours. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8_MWw1lMrzQ

We've built four core features:

**🤖 Carousel Chat** - Build complete multi-tab models from scratch with conversational prompts. No Excel expertise required. [Models that took hours to spin up now take minutes.](https://youtu.be/dQJbqbEJIiY)

**⚡ Quick Fix** - Select any range, hit Ctrl+Enter, and describe what you want. [Format tables, add analytics, or restructure data instantly.](https://youtu.be/BeXluYKKArM)

**🔍 Model Walkthrough** - Understand complex formulas in plain English. [Model Walkthrough rewrites formulas by swapping cell references like S&U_Sheet!K7 with Transaction Closing Costs (4%).](https://youtu.be/sG3s4Bz1sM0)

**📄 File Context** - Stop doing manual data entry. [Carousel pulls information from your documents and puts them into your Excel file live, complete with automatic source citations.](https://youtu.be/jDx9lNbgLMk)

Unlike your last intern, Carousel is competent, doesn’t complain when asked to fix spreadsheet formatting, and doesn’t need a return offer.

Carousel is what Microsoft’s Copilot for Excel promised to be.

# **Who's It Made For?**

Carousel is designed for anyone who spends significant time in Excel:

* **Financial analysts** building complex financial models
* **Marketing managers** analyzing campaign performance data
* **Operations leaders** creating forecasts and tracking KPIs
* **Product managers** organizing feature roadmaps
* **Scientists** analyzing experimental data
* **Consultants** preparing client deliverables

# **Why We Made Carousel**

Excel hasn't fundamentally changed in decades, yet it remains central to how teams & businesses operate. 

We built Carousel to bridge the gap between Excel's insane professional capabilities and its usability challenges.

# **Try Carousel Today**

Our open beta starts today for both individuals and enterprise teams. We'd love your feedback!

If you spend more than 10 hours a week in Excel or know someone who does, we'd love to chat: [founders@usecarousel.com](mailto:founders@usecarousel.com)

launches.body:
Hi! We’re [Jude](https://linkedin.com/in/jude-rizzo-aa71aa207) & [Daniel](https://linkedin.com/in/daniel-wolf-6242431b1), and we’re the co-creators of [Carousel](https://www.carouseltech.io/), a change-tracking tool for PowerPoint & Excel.

 

**Investment bankers & consultants don’t use PowerPoint like you do:**

For most investment banking or consulting projects, the final deliverable is a PowerPoint deck.

 

To make sure the final draft of that deck is perfect, it goes through multiple rounds of review, feedback, & edits.

 

This means that many bankers and consultants spend hours squinting at different decks to see if the footnote on pg. 57 was updated correctly or if all the companies in a table on pg. 34 have uniform EBITDA adjustments.

 

Small details matter a lot, so teams often have to check over hundred-page decks from scratch. This review process is tedious & prone to mistakes.

 

**Track deck & model changes with one click:**

 

Carousel is a PowerPoint & Excel add-in that captures all the changes made to your team’s materials from shell to client PDF.

 

**Carousel tells you exactly WHO changed WHAT and WHEN.** With one click, the add-in highlights everything that changed between any two versions of the model or deck (in your current window, without having to open another file).

 

# It’s like Word’s track changes on steroids.

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78887&key=user_uploads/857855/b80c80b4-4489-4207-be22-dc1681bc6eb6)

 

Before this, Daniel worked at Bank of America & Elliott Management, where he spent many hours pushing the boundaries of what was possible in PowerPoint & Excel.

 

Jude was pursuing a Master’s Degree in Mathematics from Cornell with a focus on ML.

 

We realized that PowerPoint & Excel could be a much more pleasant experience for power users with the right tools.

 

**If you or someone you know spends more than 15 hours per week in PowerPoint or Excel, **[**let’s chat**](https://calendly.com/daniel-carouseltech)**.**

launches.tagline: AI agents that communicate with customers across the entire financial journey
launches.body:
## TL;DR

Financial services has always been a relationship business.

* In the U.S., people spend 10 billion minutes a year on the phone with their bank
* Only 60% of customer interactions occur during business hours
* Our customers use Monumint to increase operational capacity by 4x while delivering a 24/7 high-touch customer experience

From opening a deposit account to financing a home or growing a business, trust is built through millions of conversations between financial institutions and their customers.

At Monumint, we're building conversational AI that helps financial institutions communicate with every customer on a more personal level. From account opening and lending to servicing and collections, our AI agents support the entire financial journey.

<https://youtu.be/kRdb2afGcrA>

## **❌** The problem

Financial services is one of the largest industries in the world.

Each year in the US there are more than 80 million new consumer and small business loans. There are more than 4,500 banks, 4,500 credit unions, and thousands of mortgage lenders, consumer lenders, and fintechs, all aiming to build lasting relationships with their customers.

Despite this, much of the industry still relies on manual customer operations. Teams spend countless hours following up with customers, chasing documents, answering the same questions, and updating multiple systems.

## **✅** The solution

Monumint is built around three pillars.

**Conversational.** Customers communicate through voice, SMS, email, and built-in web chat.

launches.title: ⚡️OmniAI - Structure your unstructured data
launches.tagline: Transform unstructured data into beautiful SQL tables.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋 We’re Anna and Tyler from [OmniAI](https://getomni.ai/), and we help clean up data using AI.

### **🪄 Omni in action: Turn YC demo day videos into data**

Here we started with a database of all the public demo day videos and extracted some of the most interesting business metrics — without needing to watch hundreds of videos.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=78643&key=user_uploads/457262/b93d8e72-4fe5-4e43-b2a2-000512664002)

# **Problem**

A company’s most valuable data set is often its least accessible. Only 20% of corporate data lives in SQL, with the remaining 80% locked away in unstructured formats (reviews, chat logs, transcripts, pdfs). It takes some serious engineering work to answer questions like:

* “Graph the most common user complaints over the last 4 years”
* “What percentage of users complain about pricing on sales calls”
* “How many users are getting their questions answered by our chatbot”

**And this problem will only get worse as AI interfaces become more ubiquitous and more user data is locked up in chat logs. 🤖**

.

# **How are people solving this today?**

Even YC founders don’t have a unified strategy here. From the hundreds of companies we’ve interviewed, it usually boils down to:

**🌎 Outsourced data entry** - Slow and _surprisingly inaccurate_

🔎 **Spot checking** - Slow and very prone to bias (i.e. _read 10 user reviews and make sweeping business decisions)_

💸 **Hire some ML engineers** - Best results, but it’s going to be slow and expensive

.

# **Solution**

Use OmniAI to turn that unstructured data into tabular data. OmniAI makes it simple to transform and enhance unstructured data, all within your existing data warehouse.

* No engineering time needed
* No calibrating models
* And certainly no fighting with AWS SageMaker.

![](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=78643&key=user_uploads/457262/3650ce0e-79d1-4405-9a63-8b0282947c88)

# **How it works**

Run ML models across your data. Categorize, extract, summarize, translate, and more.

* **Connect to a data warehouse -** We support Snowflake, Postgres, MySQL, and MongoDB.
* **Choose models to run -** Define type safe schemas to run against your unstructured data. Use any of the hosted models, or define your own.
* **Transform your data -** We’ll run those models against your data, and keep your warehouse in sync as new rows/fields are added/deleted.
* **Query with SQL -** All the transformed data stays in your warehouse. Surface this data in your product, or analyze with your existing BI tools.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78643&key=user_uploads/457262/b2be4691-e98e-44cb-a76e-103b59d51b1e)

# **Meet Tyler & Anna**

[Anna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/annapoj/) comes from building ETLs and data enrichment tools at [**Hightouch**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/12821). While [Tyler](https://linkedin.com/in/tyler-maran) has a background in ML and healthcare applications (most recently at [**Fair Square**](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/13215)). We’ve dealt with everything from syncing CRMs to fax machine APIs.

We’re building Omni because we hate working with messy data, and we can make this problem a little better for everyone.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78643&key=user_uploads/457262/25bd169d-bbe0-4c42-ac0b-fbfe55589067)

# **Our ask**

* **Data problems!** We’re constantly adding new tools and would love to hear about the unique data problems you face.
* **Book a demo** with us at [getomni.ai](https://getomni.ai/)
* **Tell people about Omni!** Know anyone drowning in a sea of PDFs, or trying to build image classification from scratch? Chances are we can help!

Email us at [**founders@getomni.ai**](mailto:founders@getomni.ai)

name: Bayesline
long_description:
Bayesline is building a GPU-powered financial analytics suite for institutional investors, like hedge funds. 

Clients use our cloud deployed solution to build custom analytics in seconds, having previously been frustrated with off the shelf solutions that don't generate any alpha. What used to take weeks or months now happens near instantly. 

Sebastian, CFA (ex Bloomberg Quant & AI Research) and Misha, PhD (ex BlackRock Managing Director) met while working at BlackRock in 2016. With a combined 20 years of experience in the space they set out to change the way the industry uses analytics - from one size doesn't fit all to truly tailored to clients' needs.
one_liner: Highly customizable and blazingly fast analytics for asset managers.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: We met in 2016 at BlackRock, and lived together during Covid. We both have a very strong mission to revolutionize financial analytics. We thought that the world’s most renowned institutions would be the best place to do that. But it turns out that they move too slowly and are not ready to truly innovate, especially in the age of AI. Leaving our lucrative careers was the only way to pursue our dreams.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: All of financial analytics was built in the 90s on fundamentally an outdated tech stack (C++ on CPUs). The AI community has developed a new stack (Python ML packages on GPUs) that is orders of magnitude faster, both in time-to-market and run-time. Our aim is to rebuild all of financial analytics on this stack; from economic scenario simulation engines for banks and insurers to portfolio risk models for hedge funds. In the future, Bayesline will be integrated in all financial institutions, eliminating the days of waiting for calculation that tens of thousands of industry professionals have to deal with.

launches.body:
**TL:DR;** We figured out how to fit custom equity factor risk models in seconds instead of weeks. And we can do this across the entire financial analytics landscape. Ad hoc thematic factor construction (think COVID), risk decomposition through time, optimized factor selection, all on the fly and in seconds.

Try out our demo [here](https://app.bayesline.com/signup).

# Why does it matter?

We each spent nearly a decade at BlackRock and Bloomberg, building products, leading research teams, and empathizing with frustrated clients. They sit at the cutting edge of investment research, coming up with market-beating strategies. **Yet they have to make do with a 20-year-old analytics toolkit** that current vendors offer. 

We are changing that. If the AI community can fit a 300 billion parameter model, there’s no reason why a factor risk model should take a week to compute. In fact, it doesn’t. **We figured out how to do it live and in seconds, and we can do it across the entire analytics landscape**. 

# Who is behind this?

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82831&key=user_uploads/1931855/9d15dc8d-f99b-481f-b378-4f1f9c630691)

Hi, we’re Sebastian and Misha.

[**Sebastian**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sebastianjanisch/)**, CFA** built his expertise in quant research during his time as a Director in BlackRock’s Financial Modeling Group where he implemented and researched equity risk models that analyze trillions in assets.

Prior to Bayesline, he was at Bloomberg, where he incubated the next generation of customizable and actionable quant products as part of the Quant & AI Research group.

A computer scientist by training with M.Sc. in Finance and a passion for quant research, Sebastian spent the last 10 years leveraging the power of machine learning to challenge, innovate, and reshape how institutions think about financial modeling.

[**Misha**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mishavanbeek/)**, PhD** was among the youngest Managing Directors at BlackRock. He headed the portfolio risk research team that evolved Aladdin’s portfolio risk models across all asset classes.

He also headed the team that developed Aladdin’s economic scenario engine and investment models that manage roughly $400 billion in strategic asset allocations.

Misha has spent the past 10 years coupling his professional quant training with his personal interest in all things AI and hands-on engineering.

They can build fully customized and properly aligned models (custom universe, factors, exposure overrides, etc.) in seconds, far superior to what’s currently available. They deploy on the client cloud, ingest existing vendor data, and provide their engine to compute fully-fledged new risk models and analytics – all on the fly._

launches.body:
### **TLDR;**

LedgerUp built an AI revenue teammate—[Ari](https://ledgerup.ai/)—to eliminate the multiple tools to juggle to get from “contract signed” to “cash in the bank.” [Ari](https://ledgerup.ai/) integrates with your CRM, automates invoicing, chases payments, and lives in Slack with real-time revenue data. The result? No more manual data entry, overdue payments, scattered data, and hiring FTEs to spend countless hours wasted in back-and-forth amongst different departments.

_Below is an example of CRM → invoice process:_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86964&key=user_uploads/671520/29023983-80d3-4031-9e09-86f2d56ff162)

### **Why does this matter?**

3 out of 4 businesses face payment delays, with the root cause beginning at the invoice creation stage.

**The Pain**: Most companies juggle contract softwares (ex: DocuSign/PDFs), spreadsheets, and a manual billing process riddled with errors, overdue payments, and hours spent data-entering.

**Why It Matters**: These inefficiencies lead to missed revenue, cash flow constraints, and wasted staff time. Founders often feel they need extra full-time staff just to manage invoicing.

### **How does Ari solve this?**

Signature to Revenue, _Automatically_

Ari takes over the moment a contract is signed:

1. Zero-Touch Contract Import: Signature lands → Contract processes → Revenue flows. All automatic, all instant. 
2. Intelligent Revenue Automation: Every signed agreement is automatically billed to its unique billing requirements
3. Real-Time Slack Updates: Approve the final output in Slack and ask questions as needed

While others offer yet another tool to learn, **your AI teammate takes over the moment a contract is signed.**

### **Our ask**

From startups to enterprises, every business faces contract-to-cash challenges. If you know revenue leaders who'd benefit from an AI billing teammate, we'd be grateful for an introduction!

Who we serve well:

* **Finance & Ops Teams:** automating billing operations while maintaining GAAP compliance
* **Founders & Revenue Leaders:** who need clear revenue visibility without the operational overhead
* **CFOs & Controllers:** seeking accurate, real-time revenue data and forecasting 💰
* **Sales & Customer Success:** teams who want to focus on relationships, not invoice follow-ups
* Email us at [founders@ledgerup.ai](mailto:founders@ledgerup.ai)

Better yet if you have a business that has contracts, **try Ari**: [Sign Up Here](https://www.ledgerup.ai/demo) or **Schedule a Call** with us: [Book a Short Call](https://cal.com/joe-ledgerup/15min).

### **Team/Origin Story**

During his years as a finance director for startups, [Joseph](https://www.linkedin.com/in/joseph-johnson-/) lived the revenue operations nightmare firsthand. His days were consumed with juggling dozens of different apps – one for contracts, another for invoicing, yet another for payment tracking, and endless spreadsheets to tie it all together. 

The "_solution_" was always to hire more FTEs to manage the chaos, but that just shifted the burden of wrestling with broken processes to someone else.

Teaming up with his childhood friend [Bailey](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bailey-spell-b487ab149/), who had been building AI Agents for the past 2 years, they recognized this wasn't just their problem – it's a universal pain for any company with contracts that need to get paid. 

They're on a mission to liberate founders and finance teams from revenue operations chaos, giving them back the time and clarity needed to focus on what matters most: growing their business.

launches.title: Benchify: Instant self-healing codegen
launches.tagline: Fix & bundle your generated code at lightspeed
launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Benchify handles the middle mile of codegen ensuring that generated code just works and is instantly executable. It’s a one-line SDK call between LLM clients and sandboxes to deliver instant code repair, accelerated bundling, and observability.

### **Who**

Anyone depending on non-human-in-the-loop codegen: – app builders, dynamic websites, agents, etc.

### **Problem**

Generated code breaks — constantly.

On top of normal bugs like duplicate function calls, parse errors, or missing or extra parens, AI systems introduce new ones, such as stray tool calls, /\* rest of code goes here \*/, and malformed diff applications. Running that code inside sandboxes only compounds the pain: every piece has to be perfect for execution to succeed, and the sandbox boot time delays the inevitable. Since all the sandboxes are just firecracker VMs designed to run anything, they’re not optimized for the common workflows builders actually care about. The result is slow setup, fragile execution, and painful feedback loops.

* **Missed errors**: Users hit error screens as soon as code loads in the browser. 
* **Delayed generations**: LLM-based auto-healing stretches generation times, slowing iteration.\
  **Token burn**: Edge-case failures trigger endless retries that chew through tokens without progress.  Often bugs are inherently out-of-distribution and thus hard to fix with AI.
* **Setup lag**: Sandboxes take 30-120s to boot before code even runs, adding cold-boot lag to the rep-cycle when there’s an error.
* **Lost data:** Sandboxes don’t easily track errors and the errors or only show the first (breaking) bug, making it hard to detect all the errors in code at once to push improvements 
* **Templates:** The use of templates speeds up sandboxes but leads to even more brittleness as the template has to be in perfect lockstep with the codegen.

 

### **Solution**

Benchify combines **non-AI techniques** (static analysis + program synthesis) with **highly optimized infrastructure** to deliver _turn-key code_ — fixed and bundled — in O(1 second).

It drops in as a **one-line SDK call** between your LLM client and the sandbox. If you’re only doing front-end work, you can skip the sandbox entirely and render directly from Benchify’s bundled output.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94193&key=user_uploads/1661832/dcd85900-d61c-47e4-b71e-0ef6244e5fd0)

**Code Repair**: Sub second fixes for parsing, dependency, CSS/Tailwind, type, and interaction errors (e.g. empty-Select) with more on the way. If there’s an issue you’re running into, let us know and we can add a fix!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94193&key=user_uploads/1661832/5d3a354c-69ee-4f5c-8437-0d0360f28874)

**Bundling**: Build and dependency resolution in 1-3s.

* _Front-end_: Returns code that instantly renders on client via our SDK.
* _Full-stack_: Bundles code that executes in any sandbox (skipping slow dependency & build steps) — the only delay left is sandbox cold boot.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94193&key=user_uploads/1661832/10606bbc-8df4-43f8-a574-aa9f0bd97d26)

**Observability**: Analytics on error patterns in generated code.

**Product Demo** 

https://youtu.be/my7yzpp8AqY

### **How it works**

Benchify’s analysis engine detects bugs and dispatches them to a growing library of static repair strategies in a fraction of a second. Strategies are optimized for different bug types, and layered using an incremental parsing approach, since sometimes fixing one bug unlocks others.  Each candidate fix is re-analyzed, with the best one selected automatically provided it yields a strict improvement in the code.  The architecture builds on prior research in _program synthesis_ and _program repair_, where the idea is to have a collection of strategies that may or may not work at fixing different bug types, combined with an analysis and execution engine that can efficiently determine whether or not a strategy succeeded.

### **Story**

We entered YC with a formal-methods-driven code review product. But unreliable LLM-generated test harnesses kept breaking it. Talking with builders made it clear: **the real bottleneck was brittle codegen itself.** We pivoted to focus entirely on making generated code self-healing.

### **Ask**

We’re focused on app builders today, but our core tech generalizes: agents, self-updating sites, programmatic ads, and more.

If generated code is slowing you down, let’s talk.

launches.title: Benchify: Automatic code reviews that work
launches.tagline: Better testing without writing tests.
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83014&key=user_uploads/1661832/cb65a61c-fa84-4ccf-a1d5-2f6bf33b88fa)

# TL;DR

[Benchify](https://www.benchify.com/) is a code review tool that uncovers real bugs by actually running your code on strategically generated inputs, using methods typically restricted to rocket science and chip design.  When errors are found, Benchify provides verified bugs, unit tests, and a patch (coming soon).

# The problem

Engineers (like you) spend almost half their time testing and debugging, which, let’s be honest, they’d rather spend doing literally anything else.

* **Lower velocity:** Projects are delayed by testing & debugging
* **Site outages:** Despite all the effort, critical errors slip through, leading to site outages and other failures
* **Low test coverage:** Developing exhaustive tests is nearly impossible and generally put off for later…
* **Shallow test depth:** Testing is limited to a few hard-coded cases

# The solution

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83014&key=user_uploads/1661832/ed5d818b-cba4-41cf-9ca7-f9b9ca419737)

We test your code using _magic_ (ok, formal methods) and deliver the results in an actionable comment on your PR.

* **Automatic logical blueprint:** Benchify automatically writes a blueprint that says how your code is intended to function
* **Run thousands of tests:** Benchify tests your code against the blueprint using thousands of strategically generated inputs
* **Provide counterexamples:** Concrete, minimal counterexamples are provided when code fails so you can easily debug
* **Generate unit tests:** We automatically translate counterexamples into unit tests for easy reproducibility and test-driven development
* **Propose solutions:** When Benchify detects an error, it attempts to propose a solution, which it subjects to the same battery of tests as the original code

## Does it work?

The testing techniques Benchify uses are typically leveraged for mission critical use cases, such as silicon chip design, rocket engineering, and high-speed trading. Our secret sauce is in making these techniques usable and actionable. 

# The Team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83014&key=user_uploads/1661832/09a8c140-f845-4f96-9113-6daac4963be2)

Max and Juan first met as bright-eyed freshmen at Dartmouth College almost a decade ago and have been fast friends and on-and-off roommates since.  They’re deeply passionate about software assurance (who isn’t?) and excited to test your code.

* [**Max**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/max-von-hippel-3b90742a8/) holds a PhD in Computer Science from Northeastern University, focused on security and interactive theorem proving. He has worked at NASA, the DoD 😉, and Galois. Most importantly, he holds a Blue Belt from 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu. 
* [**Juan**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/juan-castano97/) built and sold a business, helped companies like Instawork and Klaviyo grow, and advised on deals at McKinsey. Juan double-majored in Economics and survival skills at Dartmouth (okay, the second one isn’t official), and later picked up an MBA from MIT, where he unfortunately missed out on a chance to test his skills with the [pirate certificate](https://physicaleducationandwellness.mit.edu/about/pirate-certificate/).

# Asks

* Hop on a [call](https://calendly.com/d/cpyy-ffc-ynf/juan-max-30-min) with us to try out Benchify or talk about your frustrations with software testing
* [Try out](http://www.benchify.com) our beta code reviewer and give us feedback
* Shoot us an email at [hello@benchify.com](mailto:hello@benchify.com) with your biggest backend software testing pain points, and we’ll see if we can help out!

name: FINNY AI
long_description:
FINNY is the AI-native organic growth engine for financial advisors, focused on helping them grow their practices
 
Our goal is to empower financial advisors to reach the right potential clients at the right time, with the right message.  We are building a world where anyone who wants financial advice can connect with the right advisor, while helping advisors ensure organic growth, the most existential problem advisors face. 
                                                                                                                                                      
The organic growth process has historically been highly inefficient and full of noise. Advisors often waste 60+ hours of business development to convert 1 new client.  

At FINNY, we are certain we can do better with AI. With our tool, advisors can:
- Identify prospects within their target niche, aggregating thousands of data points per lead
- Prioritize prospects based on their predicted likelihood of converting using F-Score, a score unique to each advisor and prospect pair
- Automate the outreach and meeting scheduling with their high priority prospects

In essence, FINNY does all the rote work for the advisors, letting them focus on what actually matters: the client relationship.

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we are Theo, Eden, and Victoria — the founders of [FINNY](https://www.finnyai.com/). We help independent financial advisors find and convert new clients, using AI.\
\
If you’re confused as to why the three of us are so excited about building for financial advisors, keep reading.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/89898/9cd181f2-59e6-4458-b5c9-250b9399ee43)

# 🧑‍🔬 **The Team**

**🏦The Sales Whisperer**  

[Eden](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edenovadia/) was most recently at BCG NYC, where she primarily worked in the Tech, Financial Institutions & Private Equity practices. She holds a BEng in Software Engineering from McGill (ML focus). 

**👾The Model Man** 

[Theo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/theodore-janson/) worked as a ML engineer at an early Fintech startup and AI researcher in Explainable ML. He holds a BEng in EE and Math from McGill and MS in AI from Ecole Polytechnique, Paris.

**👩🏼‍🎨The Visionary** 

[Victoria](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-toli/) came from Uber, where she led membership growth for Uber One as a Product Manager. She holds a BS from Stanford in Symbolic Systems (AI focus). 

# **🫶🏻 Why are we obsessed with Financial Advisors?**

* **The Great Wealth Transfer** - $80T of wealth will be transferred from the Boomer/Silent Gen to the next generation over the next 20 years. 
* **Retiring advisors** - 45,000 financial advisors are over the age of 65 in the US, managing $3T in wealth that will change management when they retire.
* **Wealth creation** - Wealth is being created in unprecedented ways (E.g., Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Social media, Racial wealth gain), but the institution serving the wealth has not changed
* **Consolidation** - Private equity driving consolidation of a historically long tail of independent advisors
* **Price Inertia:** Financial Advisors are used to paying 25 bps annually IN PERPETUITY for referrals. That’s $200B annually from the wealth transfer alone.

 

# 💀 **The Problem FINNY is Solving**

Financial advisors manage >$100T in assets globally. Yet, bringing on new clients is highly inefficient. Their best bet is to repurpose horizontal solutions - like Linkedin, ZoomInfo, and Pitchbook - to create long and noisy prospect lists. However, without a proper way to qualify these leads or even reach their particular niche at scale, advisors end up spending an average of **58 hours** going after the wrong, often unqualified prospects before converting one new client.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/1755270/ea1b3592-dc3a-4581-86ad-447709eec5bf)

# 💡 **The Solution**

FINNY is reimagining organic growth for financial advisors with AI. Our first product, a multi-channel Sales agent, allows users to sit back and relax while it goes “out in the wild” (aka our massive database of high-net-worth individuals) and prospects for them. It’s like your intern, except it’s always on, running in the background.

FINNY’s goal is for advisors to wake up in the morning to meetings with prospects on their calendars, entirely booked by FINNY. Our value proposition is three-fold: 

1. **_Prospect identification:_**
   * _We identify prospects within their target niche, aggregating thousands of data points per lead and constantly monitoring for life triggers_

    
2. **_Prospect prioritization_:**
   * We prioritize prospects based on their predicted likelihood of converting, a score unique to each advisor and prospect pair
3. **_Prospect outreach & engagement:_**
   * _We automate the outreach and meeting scheduling with the high-priority prospects, intelligently selecting the optimal channel for the specific prospect_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/1755270/2df42888-af79-4d31-a06f-a153ff0487e7)

# ✅ **Progress so far**

In just 3 months, we have:

* Released the **1st** and **2nd iteration** of the product to 15 advisory firms.
* Grown revenue by >**11x** MoM.
* Got **70** firms to join our waitlist, without any acquisition efforts or outbound.
* **Won** Morningstar’s Fintech Showcase last month.
* Have been getting some **buzz**! [Here](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240724776742/en/Future-Proof-Announces-Groundbreaking-Lineup-of-Fintech-Demo-Drop-III-Finalists) and [here](https://www.downtownjoshbrown.com/p/future-financial-advice-already-993f).

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/1755270/5a150faf-0c65-424a-96f1-90f6e4c79b94)

# **❓One Ask for You (If you made it this far)**

If you ever thought about working with a financial advisor, evaluated one, currently work with one _(or want to get matched with one_ **😉**_),_ we’d love to talk to you. Book 15 min with us [here.](https://calendly.com/eden-finny/finny-intro-call) If you’re in SF, we’ll buy you a coffee. If not, let’s call it an IOU.

launches.title: Solar: An infinite canvas for vibe-coding production apps
launches.tagline: We build the most complicated full-stack apps, faster than anywhere else.
launches.body:
## TL;DR

Solar lets small teams collaborate with AI agents to build and deploy production apps in minutes. Like Figma, but no mockups—just real software with live data and backend Python functionality. Built by our full-stack AI agent, powered by your imagination.

https://youtu.be/Gl03z0M8BWk

## Why this, and why us?

Hi everyone! We’re Vivek, Dan, John, and Ziray: the team behind [Lumenary](http://www.lumenary.com). We met each other during our first few weeks at Dartmouth and have been best friends ever since. We’ve lived together, worked together, traveled the world together, and have even summited some notable peaks together (don’t ask about Mount Shasta).

Our team brings together engineering from Palantir, Jane Street, IMC Trading, and Flatiron Health. We’ve built enterprise-grade AI products, a capital allocation system that controls billions, a data engine that processes petabytes–we _all_ build and deploy software _quickly_ in contexts _where it cannot fail_.

Solar began as an internal tool that we used to ship enterprise demos faster than any tool on the market. We decided to productize and focus on Solar completely.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91284&key=user_uploads/1944134/0e7139b1-e4ab-4818-b5c5-040e6c1e6d37)

## The Problem

We’re a team of four engineers who’ve used nearly every AI-powered app builder. Projects started off great, but we found ourselves in an endless loop of “revert, and try again.” Most of our time was spent waiting and hoping as the LLM made changes one-at-a-time.

Even when the app seemed to work, it was unclear what were real features versus frontend demoware. We lacked an understanding of the architecture, dataflow, and what vulnerabilities were left open. It felt like these platforms had prioritized making neat frontends and bolted on real functionality as an afterthought.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91284&key=user_uploads/1944134/f231fdfb-a63c-4006-a269-db8dd2df2376)

## What we do

We loved three things:

* Figma’s flexibility — work on many designs with many people
* Cursor’s power — write production code with LLMs
* Retool’s safety — ship apps that you know work

We combined those to make Solar.

Solar’s AI agents collaborate alongside you on a multiplayer canvas. You can see the relationships and data flow between database tables, backend Python logic, and frontend pages.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=91284&key=user_uploads/1944134/12b01a63-bcd6-430d-bb33-4b274d542423)

Solar makes apps production-worthy by combining LLM-generated code with deterministic code generation for databases, services, and authentication. This makes your apps maintainable and deployable past the MVP, and able to integrate nicely with existing infrastructure.

We’re the most agentic platform on the market: Solar will read logs, interact with your application, and work for minutes or even hours unattended to get it perfect.

## Our Ask

Sign up at https://solarapp.dev and try building an app.

**tl;dr: **[**Thyme**](https://www.meetthyme.com/)** enables financial advisors to run 10x better meetings. We cover meeting prep, transcription, summarization, CRM syncing, and document parsing. Please introduce us to any financial advisor in your network!**

# 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 About us

We are Fernando San Martin (left), and Daniel Lantz (right). We've worked together at Capital One, trovata.io, Campfire (YC S23) and are now Thyme co-founders. Our mission is to build better software tools for financial advisors.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82372&key=user_uploads/847698/1370b41c-bff4-402b-be93-fc40ffa032cb)

# **❗ The Problem**

Financial advisors spend hours every day preparing, running, and following up on client meetings. Their attention is split between engaging with the client and taking meaningful notes, and often, these notes are incomplete or non-existent.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82372&key=user_uploads/847698/3e9d6239-57f1-4a34-b794-7223d5eef16b)

After finishing the meeting, the advisor has to expand on the few scattered words that they jotted down to create follow-up tasks and update their CRM with the new client insights.

# ✅ **Our Solution**

Thyme solves all of the above. Using our app, the advisor can see their upcoming meetings, for which they can prepare by viewing a holistic profile about the client and even asking natural language questions.

Once in the meeting, our app uses state-of-the-art AI technology to transcribe, summarize, generate action items, and draft follow-up emails.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82372&key=user_uploads/847698/554cca4a-0ea6-40f2-ad21-effa09f00d16)

Finally, our powerful integrations with the rest of the advisors’ tech stack also allow us to initiate workflows and send tasks and notes to other systems. Any financial documents submitted by the client are parsed and integrated into their profile.

Our users describe the solution as a game-changer that saves them hours each week while creating much richer and more accurate notes and tasks that sync seamlessly with their stack.

# 🙏 **Request**

* If you like what we are building, upvote, comment, and follow us on [Linkedin.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/thyme-yc-s24/)
* If you know of any financial advisors in your network, ask them if they would be interested in chatting. Here is a potential blurb you can use to introduce us: "[Thyme](https://www.meetthyme.com) is changing how financial advisors run online meetings. Would you like to hear more directly from the team?"

launches.title: Blaze - AI CFO for Businesses
launches.tagline: An AI CFO that pays your bills, collects your invoices, and forecasts your cash.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Blaze is an agent that runs the entire finance function for your business: pay bills, accept payments, forecast your cash flow, and keep your books current. Install it with **npx @blaze-money/cli**. Use it with your favorite agentic harness or at blaze.money/agentic-finance. ChatGPT, Claude apps, and OpenClaw plugin coming soon.\
\
Our launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ulOQ2cVK9Ds>

## ❌ The problem

You're a lean team busy doing more than you can handle already, and finances feel like a perpetual weight on your shoulders. You know there are bills to pay, invoices to collect on, questions you want answered. But a real finance team costs $10,000 to $20,000 a month, and you could always "do it yourself," so the problem goes on dangling, half solved, half annoyance, always taking up RAM.

What ends up happening is bills get paid late, you spend money on some $300/month marketing software your interns bought months ago without you knowing, and real problems with your vendors, payroll, and runway sneak up on you at 2am on Sunday.

We've lived this personally. As a 3 year old, super lean fintech team running all our own finances, we know what it's like trying to keep the finances afloat while doing everything else it takes to make it big. It's not like the work is rocket science. It's just constant, manual, nagging, and spread across 18 different tools that need sense making.

Until recently, you had to pay $10,000 a month to hire a finance function. We'd like to change that.

## 🛠 What we built

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108616&key=user_uploads/85958/4ef6fa06-6115-4df5-bacf-cc481a437e15)

\
Chat with Blaze from your favorite agentic harness and watch it get real things done for your finances:

* **Pay bills and contractors.** Tell it to pay the AWS bill and it finds the invoice, shows you the amount, and pays on your approval. "Send Maria $3,000 for the design work" works the same way, domestic or international.
* **Collect payments and send invoices.** "Send Acme a payment link for $12,500." Blaze creates the link, sends it, and updates you when it's paid. Draft a real invoice the same way, from a one-line request. If a client drags their feet, it follows up automatically.
* **Forecast cash.** Connects to your bank through Plaid, finds the recurring patterns, and projects your balance so you know your runway.
* **Handle the pre-accounting.** Categorizes transactions and matches them to the bills and invoices they belong to as they happen, so your actual accounting is easier when you get to it.
* **Move stablecoins.** On and off-ramps USDC across 80+ currencies, with support for cards and various local payment methods around the world.
* **Flag problems early.** Tells you about a low balance, an overdue invoice, or unusual spend before it becomes an issue.

It installs with one command:

```
npx @blaze-money/cli
```

You can use it anywhere you use AI agents. Our favorites are in Hermes on Telegram and on the dashboard at dashboard.blaze.money. There's a REST API and SDK if you want to connect it to your own systems.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108616&key=user_uploads/85958/492a039d-5aeb-4cab-bc85-33fe8f82f1c0)

## 🙏 Ask

If you are, or you know, any of the following, we'd love to hear from you.

**Founders running lean**

You're doing your own bills, invoicing, and cash flow because a real finance team costs $10,000 to $20,000 a month. Try it and tell us what breaks: **npx @blaze-money/cli** or <https://blaze.money/agentic-finance>.

**Early customers**

We're onboarding our first businesses now, and want people who'll help us decide what the agent should handle next. Especially focused on handyman and trades businesses (HVAC, repair, remodeling) and property managers, especially in the Airbnb space.

**Anyone with an intro**

To founders and small teams who'd rather not open their bank again. You can reach us at [founders@blaze.money](mailto:founders@blaze.money).

## 👥 Team

Faiyam is a full-stack engineer who dropped out of med school to build startups instead. As a founding engineer at Luc's previous startup, he helped it scale to $1m in ARR. He manages finances for Blaze, and is personally relieved he no longer needs to stay up on Sunday nights to do so.

Luc is a two-time founder. His first startup hit #1 on the App Store. Before that, he was a tech lead at Spotify and Artsy. Luc built Blaze's cross-border payment rails after living the problem firsthand, moving money in and out of Latin America.

Fun fact: Luc and Faiyam met after Faiyam "coincidentally" sat down next to him at a coffee shop in Williamsburg, New York, seven years ago. The rest is history (in the making).

launches.title: PathPilot - AI Platform for Lenders
launches.tagline: AI agents that help lenders grow without scaling operational headcount.
launches.body:
Today, we’re launching PathPilot Agents for Lending: specialized AI agents that help consumer lenders automate origination, servicing, collections, and quality on their operations.

## The problem

Consumer lenders need to grow, but lending operations are still expensive, manual, and dependent on large internal teams and external vendors.

Borrowers are often asked to submit the same information multiple times, wait for manual reviews, and navigate disconnected processes across origination, servicing, and collections.

For lenders, this means higher operating costs, slower decisions, inconsistent customer experiences, and difficulty scaling without adding more headcount.

Current AI solutions are not enough. Without specialization, guardrails, and the right operational context, agent quality breaks down—especially in regulated, customer-facing workflows.

## What we built

PathPilot builds specialized AI agents for lending operations, powered by a proprietary harness that connects AI models directly to each lender’s workflows, systems, policies, and data.

It starts with the **Origination Agent**, which guides borrowers through WhatsApp or web forms, collects the right information, pre-verifies documents, and connects with underwriting, identity, and fraud systems to support faster decisions.

Once the loan is active, the **Servicing Agent** helps customers with payments, balances, questions, and account updates across voice, WhatsApp, chat, and email.

When a payment is missed, the **Collections Agent** follows up compliantly, keeps full conversation and account context, connects with call center and CRM systems, and negotiates next steps to drive resolution.

Behind every workflow, the **Audit and Quality Agent** reviews every interaction and action, identifies quality or compliance risks, and provides actionable feedback that helps both human teams and AI agents improve continuously.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aAQ1mLB-qPo>

## One agent or a coordinated workforce

Lenders can start with a single agent for one workflow or deploy a coordinated workforce of agents that work together and share context.

For example, the Origination Agent can pass a customer’s application history to the Servicing Agent. If the account later becomes delinquent, the Collections Agent can use the same operational context rather than starting the relationship from zero.

The Audit and Quality Agent works across the entire system, creating a continuous feedback loop that improves accuracy, customer experience, and compliance.

Because PathPilot is built on a modular framework, internal AI and engineering teams can extend, customize, and ultimately own the system as their capabilities grow.

We do not want lenders to become permanently dependent on another black-box vendor. We want to give them a reliable foundation for building and operating their own AI workforce.

## Why we built this

The problem became personal when I tried to finance my first car after moving to the U.S.

I had no local credit history and very little understanding of how the process worked. I went through a long and frustrating process in which multiple lenders manually reviewed my application, repeatedly requested information, and ultimately offered me a loan with very high fees.

Today, as a real estate investor, I still experience many of the same problems when applying for a mortgage or refinancing a property. The process remains slow, repetitive, and difficult to navigate—even when you understand how lending works.

There needs to be a better way.

Before PathPilot, David and I spent years building and operating AI first products at Meta. We learned that making AI work reliably in production requires much more than choosing a model. It requires integrations, evaluations, guardrails, feedback loops, and deep operational context.

We started PathPilot to bring that infrastructure to lending—so lenders can operate more efficiently and borrowers can receive a faster, clearer, and more responsive experience.

## Where we are today

PathPilot agents are already supporting fintech lenders, BNPLs, embedded lending platforms, and collections organizations across the U.S. and Latin America.

Our customers use PathPilot for workflows including conversational origination, document validation, servicing, collections, and quality assurance.

## Our ask

We would love to speak with:

* Consumer lenders, BNPLs, neobanks, and embedded lending companies
* Operations, servicing, collections, risk, and compliance leaders
* Lending platforms interested in offering specialized AI agents to their customers
* Internal AI teams looking for a framework they can customize and eventually own

Book a demo at [getpathpilot.com](http://getpathpilot.com).

We are now making UXOB available via API to a select group of early partners. Email [founders@getpathpilot.com](https://mailto:founders@getpathpilot.com) or [schedule a call](https://calendly.com/vlad-getpathpilot/30min) if you are interested in learning more.

UXOB is an AI model that ingests session replay files and generates user session data like narratives, summaries, tags, and alerts. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83625&key=user_uploads/707937/08220806-5300-45a6-b804-ef709e81b744)

### Why are we building UXOB?

Most session replays end up unused, despite containing invaluable information about user experiences. UXOB helps companies unlock the hidden potential of their user experience data to power new features and automation. 

### Who did we build UXOB for?

UXOB is built for companies that offer session replays as part of their platform. Our API is designed to be compatible with rrweb-based providers, and we are expanding to other formats. We also support companies with an existing session replay provider that want to build custom automations or features based on their user journeys. 

### How do you get started?

We’re opening up UXOB to a select group of early partners. If you’re interested in incorporating AI-driven session replay observation into your product offering or internal workflows, get in touch with us at [founders@getpathpilot.com](mailto:founders@getpathpilot.com) or [book a time](https://calendly.com/vlad-getpathpilot/30min). \

we find bugs in your voice agents - (including hallucinations, interruptions, transcription errors, and sentiment errors), so you don’t have to manually call your agents or listen to conversation recordings ever again. watch our launch video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cnhf3Vs5Dcw)

traditionally, voice AI developers

* LLM hallucinations 🤯
* interruptions 🗣️

We also understand the financial domain intimately well – our starting point has always been to build something that would have saved us hours per day as hedge fund analysts.

launches.body:
### **TL;DR**

Trata gives hedge funds un-biased, unfiltered stock analysis from anonymous Analysts at well-known funds. Our AI agents interview Analysts at multi-billion dollar funds, capture their thinking about the stocks they know and publish it anonymously.

### **Problem:**

1. It takes buyside Analysts at least 3 hours to figure out a company’s key narratives/points of debate - what outcomes are going to drive the share price up OR down? Examples: an ongoing lawsuit, a competitor going bankrupt, an Activist campaign, a new CEO, etc. This involves reading earnings call transcripts, initiation reports, talking to Investor Relations, reaching out to other Analysts, and piecing everything together yourself.
2. Because of the time it takes to do step 1, would-be winners/inflection points fall through the cracks all the time.
3. Current solutions (idea dinners, forums like Value Investors Club, Twitter DMs, independent research boutiques and even paid Substacks) are fragmented and biased.
4. The highest quality leads come from talking directly to fellow Analysts, but there’s never been a way to do this at scale, authentically. Until now.

### **Solution:**

We use LLMs to interview dozens of people a day, get their quick and honest takes on signals/points of debate they’re actually paying attention to, and turn that into a one-of-a-kind research product. Each conversation is with an anonymous hedge fund Analyst who is deeply familiar with the company – think an expert network where the hedge funds are the experts. Contributors share their knowledge to gain access to an exponentially bigger pool of expertise.

We don’t provide investment advice; we just get you up to speed – fast. We work directly with the compliance teams of multi-billion dollar hedge funds and have a team of human lawyers to ensure SEC compliance.

We are building the product I wish I had as an Analyst. Our first user interviews liked the idea so much (without any code built) that they are now our angels.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gE_Ovy1BiTM>

### **Here’s how to think about our value proposition:**

If a fund manages $300 million, one successful idea (3% position, +50% return) generates $4.5 million in profit and $900K in fees ($720/180K split between the Portfolio Manager and Analyst). This is a 750X, 120X, and 30X ROI on a $6K subscription for the Fund, Portfolio Manager and Analyst.

All it takes is one decent idea for Trata to be a home run.

### **Our Ask:**

If you are a hedge fund Analyst or know any hedge fund Analysts / public investors, please reach out! They don't have to be at a big fund like Citadel for us to be interested. We pay very well. They will most likely thank you for the intro. We guarantee anonymity. Contact us at [founders@trytrata.com](mailto:founders@trytrata.com).

### **Our Team’s Story:**

Eric and Will met at Cornell as undergrads. Eric and Alex met in high school English and grew up in the same hometown.

[Eric](https://www.linkedin.com/in/emc329/): 4.5 years as a Senior Analyst at a Long/Short Hedge Fund covering tech companies globally. Applied Economics (summa cum laude) at Cornell. Posts on Value Investors Club for fun, Sohn Idea Contest Finalist in 2021, has traveled to 20+ countries in the past few years.

[Will](https://www.linkedin.com/in/william-m-gao/): UChicago PhD Student (ML/AI). Research Scientist Intern at Meta’s Reality Labs, Nvidia’s Deep Imagination Lab, and Adobe Research. Full-time ML Engineer at Meta. CS/Stats/Math triple major in three years and a Master’s in CS his fourth year at Cornell. Globally ranked in certain online video games.

[Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alexanderqchen/): Senior Software Engineer at Titan (YC S18, Series C backed by a16z), Engineer 7 at Medallion (Series C backed by Sequoia), Software Engineer at Oscar Health a year before its IPO. CS degree from UCLA. Took a gap year to pursue bootstrapped entrepreneurship in Taiwan. By far the best chef in the apartment.

launches.tagline: Give your apps full value provenance for reasoning across documents!
launches.body:
Hello from Greg, Max and the Parsewise team! 👋

# **TL;DR**

[Parsewise](https://www.parsewise.ai/api?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=api_launch) turns multiple documents into a single structured response. Cross-document entity linking, contradiction detection, bounding boxes and UI toolkit to show it all included.

[See it live!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1cSuZal03s)

**The Problem**

Today, you have to build and maintain complex document processing pipelines with changing business rules. You parse, classify, and rely on structured responses from LLMs or IDP tools (e.g., Reducto) to get individual extraction results that you piece together with other bits of information. There’s no reliable way to catch when information contradicts itself, which is risky. Finally, you build a custom verification UI for your operations team to deal with LLM mistakes.

**The Solution**

We provide an API to abstract all that away into a single call. You provide multiple documents and the desired output to get back a response with resolved values, flagged contradictions, and full traceability across documents / pages that you can display in your own app.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=101959&key=user_uploads/1910315/a837442e-b7af-4113-acfd-699fc5074dff)

**Get Started**

=======================================================

  Sign up with free credits: [https://www.parsewise.ai/get-started](https://www.parsewise.ai/get-started?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=api_launch)\
  (use the [Agents.md](https://api.parsewise.ai/AGENTS.md) for a 1m integration)

=======================================================

**Story Time**

Why are we working on this, how we got to where we are, who we are working with, and where we are headed.

Greg was at Palantir trying to make sense of various Japanese insurance documents and realizing that any processing pipeline built around it was highly custom, time-consuming, and brittle. Max was on the human operator side at Bain & Co, realizing that the technology was being held back due to a trust problem.

We realized that there is this powerful new capability for general reasoning (and thus processing). Models are getting extremely good at interpreting complex documents (shout-out to the Gemini model family) and perform better than most OCR-type solutions on the market.

So we set out to build the layer that comes on top:\
1\. Provide mapping from user intent to a dynamic ontology\
2\. Use the now-abundant intelligence to reason across documents to get to the right results\
3\. Provide the provenance trace and validation UX that is required in many use cases

We are working with leading customers, both small and large, like UBS, Compre Group, Thinksurance, and more. They rely on Parsewise to streamline submission intake, claim portfolio risk assessment, etc., for both API based integrations and operational workflows.

With this launch, we are inviting developers to build more reliable and delightful workflows around their unstructured data processing. As we scale, we are excited to be helping with the end-to-end integration and deterministically filling forms, mapping to 3rd party APIs and web portals.

\
See more at [https://www.parsewise.ai/api](https://www.parsewise.ai/api?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=api_launch)

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** We are building Cursor for Lawyers. We turn Microsoft Word into an IDE for contracts, and build agents operating in the background. Our initial focus is on Transactional Law Firms, and agents built for quality-assuring projects and documents according to the firm’s best practice.

We have already rolled out Vesence firm-wide at our first enterprise client with a lot of love from both associates and partners.

Know any Transactional Lawyers? Let’s connect: [founders@vesence.com](mailto:founders@vesence.com).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nr1Q7S6A84I

**Problem:**

Imagine programming in Apple Notes.

No linting, no cursor, you are on your own.

That is how it is for many lawyers to draft and review contracts in Microsoft Word.

At law firms, the stakes are extremely high. Every mistake can hurt your reputation badly. Associates need to deliver under time pressure, partners demand extreme attention to detail, and your clients will not accept any blunders.

Given the attention to detail needed in the work, working on complex projects under constant time pressure, we are starting with quality-assuring agents (i.e. a linting system for contracts).

The consequences of shipping "bugs" in a legal document can be catastrophic, but even the best firm still rely on manual review to catch mistakes.

**What We’ve Built**

Vesence offers quality assurance AI agents available straight in Microsoft Word to handle tasks such as:

* **Apply firm-wide Standards**: Apply writing style guides and best practices consistently across all practice groups in the firm
* **Ensure project-level alignment**: Flag inconsistencies across multiple deal documents, for example auto-checking the SPA against the original term sheet
* **Verify document consistency**: Catch defined term slips, bad cross-references, logical gaps, and miscalculations within a single document

launches.tagline: An AI agent that builds and runs an internet business for you
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103214&key=user_uploads/2656097/bfeee97f-7eb2-42d3-ad2e-b02cfc5ee724)

Hey everyone 👋

On Monday, June 15th, at 8am PST we're launching **Locus Founder** (<https://locusfounder.com/>), an AI agent stack that builds and runs an internet business for you. You bring the idea, it does the rest, and you drive the whole thing by texting it (iMessage, SMS, Telegram, or web).

**What it does**

Text it an idea and it goes to work. It researches you and proposes a business aligned to who you are, does market research across 40+ paid data APIs, generates a full brand kit, and builds and deploys a real full-stack website (frontend, backend, database, the works). From there it sources products (print-on-demand, digital goods, or a curated catalog of 500+ dropshippable products), runs outbound across email and social, sources leads from Apollo, Google Maps, Reviews, Instagram, YouTube, and Yelp, generates short-form video ads and posts them to Meta, and handles payments (USDC direct transfers, card in/out). Loki, our mascot, is the face guiding you through all of it.

**Demo video:** <https://www.loom.com/share/3796f2a13afb48d69e83a92d9debe963>

**The backstory**

A lot of you watched the earlier pieces ship, so the arc will be familiar.

We started with **Pay With Locus**, non-custodial wallet infrastructure so AI agents could spend money safely, with spending controls and auditability built in. The feedback was consistent: why would we give an agent money when there's nothing for it to buy?

So we built the supply. **Build With Locus** (full-stack deployments for agents via pay-per-use API endpoints), a catalog of 40+ pay-per-use data APIs, and **Checkout With Locus** (a Stripe-style, machine-readable payment SDK that takes USDC, is human-or-agent payable, and settles funds straight back into the agent's Locus wallet).

Then users hit us with the real one: why would I still give it money if it can't earn me any back? I'm not comfortable handing my agent a dollar knowing it can't reasonably make me one.

**_That question is the entire reason Locus Founder exists:_** the AI agent that earns you a dollar by running your business, just by texting it. And it's an evolution of everything we've built. Every Locus Founder user is a Pay With Locus user (credits run off our wallets), a Build With Locus deployment (sites deploy on BWL), and a consumer of our pay-per-use API suite. It's the first app anyone can pick up and use, sitting on top of all of our infrastructure.

**_The honest why underneath it:_** the K-shaped economy framing has never sat right with me. The tools to build aren't so expensive that people are fully priced out yet. There's still a window where someone can make an active effort to change their trajectory. Locus Founder is our effort. It's for the people who always wanted to start something but kept running out of time, money, skills, or resources. We're bringing the same AI tools us folks in tech have been bragging about for two years directly to everyone else, in a form they can actually use. Above all else, our goal is to earn our users a dollar.

**Launch video:** <https://youtu.be/cjFsHAWvv7w>

**Pricing (kept honest):** We’re doing limited daily free usage so people can try the product instantly. Additionally, we have a subscription for $50/mo which includes effectively unlimited access. We take 5% of profits only above $1,000/mo, and nothing under that. Our goal is truly for our users to earn.

**My asks**

1. **Try the onboarding and tell me where it's rough.** I want the brutal version. [locusfounder.com](http://locusfounder.com)
2. **Intros to anyone who's always wanted to start something but never had the time.** That's exactly who we built this for.

Thank you all. This community has been a huge part of getting us here.

Cole

launches.title: Locus – Payment infrastructure for AI agents
launches.tagline: Give AI agents spending power without losing control
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95052&key=user_uploads/2656097/b9c1fd17-80cf-4a84-b400-34fc2577f0db)

Hey YC! We’re Cole and Eliot, and we’re building **Locus,** which is payment infrastructure for AI agents. We help developers safely connect agents to funds and define exactly how those funds can be used, with agent identities, budgets, permissions, and full audit trails.

# Our Story

We came to this problem from opposite ends of the same frontier. Cole spent last summer at Coinbase, building B2B payment products and seeing firsthand how control and compliance shape financial infrastructure. Eliot was working at Scale AI, maintaining data pipelines for the world’s largest AI labs. He watched as models began to tackle sustained, open-ended tasks. Both of us realized that as agents grow more capable, the next bottleneck isn’t intelligence: it’s _trust_.

Payments are a web primitive. And as we task agents with increasingly long and noisy workflows, they will _inevitably_ need to make payments. This might mean ordering parts to complete a physical repair, paying another agent for design work, hiring a contractor for a one-off task, or making micropayments to access private data.

But today’s payment rails were built for humans, not autonomous systems. There’s no safe way to say, “this agent can spend $500/day on these vendors,” and have that rule enforced. No audit trail showing which agent authorized what and why.

# Make Them Pay — Today!

Recently, OpenAI, Google, Visa, and Coinbase all released their own agentic payment protocols. But while everyone’s racing to build the next payment rails, nobody’s building the _control_ layer: the foundation that actually gives you power over how your agents use these rails. **Locus is building exactly this.**

Locus currently supports USDC on Base, with support for ACH and wire transfers coming soon. You can give your agents spending power and start building today.

# Demo

We built a micro-task payment system where an agent evaluates work submissions, scores quality, and pays contributors automatically. You set rules like "max $50 per payout, $500/day, must include a justification." The agent handles the rest. No manual approval needed, but you have full audit trails showing who got paid, when, and why.\
https://youtu.be/ICSzoZTq9JE

# Join Us!

If you build agents, join our beta and help shape the future of agent-driven finance! Learn more and sign up at [paywithlocus.com](http://paywithlocus.com). We'll give you $10 in USDC to experiment with.

We’re also building a community of builders in the space and would love for you to join. If agents with spending power sound at all interesting to you, join here to stay in the loop: https://discord.gg/TGnjUceXwE

# [https://youtu.be/6rntHGR475U\\](https://youtu.be/6rntHGR475U%5C)

Email [founders@paywithlocus.com](mailto:founders@paywithlocus.com), or find us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/paywithlocus/) or [X](https://x.com/PayWithLocus).

Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Evan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/evanameyer/) and [Jeet](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeetchugh/) – co-founders of [Mod AI](https://usemod.ai).

**Mod AI automates the manual work of processing invoices for growing enterprises.** We’ve already helped accounting teams of 1-20+ streamline their invoice processing by 83%.

**_Ask:_** Can you introduce us to CFOs, controllers, Accounting Directors, or Accounts Payable managers of mid to large companies that could benefit from streamlining their accounting processes with AI? Contact us at [evan@mod-ai.org](mailto:evan@mod-ai.org)

Most growing enterprises still process invoices manually—hiring AP clerks to comb through inboxes, type up documents, and chase approvals. As volume grows, they scramble to add more headcount or outsource to expensive temps.

1. **Cash flow blindness** – No visibility until month-end close
2. **Unscalable manual work** – More invoices means more clerks (highest-turnover role in finance)
3. **Vendor relationship damage** – Late payments and errors erode trust

We talked to 23 CFOs last month—nearly all said their AP process couldn't scale.

# 👷 Our Solution

Mod AI deploys AI agents that handle your accounts payable process end-to-end—from the moment an invoice arrives to the moment it's paid and synced to your books. Companies simply connect their systems and instantly get:

* **Complete invoice capture** 📥**:** Auto-pull from email, supplier portals, EDI, physical mail
* **Intelligent processing** 🧠**:** 97%+ accurate GL coding, 2-way/3-way matching, fraud detection
* **Seamless approval & payment** ✅**:** Custom workflows, one-click approvals, direct sync to accounting software

**Result:** Real-time spend visibility, 10x invoice volume without hiring, and stronger vendor relationships.

TL;DR - AI in legacy tools (e.g. Copilot, Gemini in Workspace, etc…) sucks. We built o11 to make automation directly inside legacy tools easy.

# See us in action (demo vid):

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0nlcwZ6bw_c>

# The Problem:

62% of all companies still rely on legacy software and systems. Many of these systems are manual, outdated, and inefficient. In the age of AI, the legacy giants that create this software aim to “duct tape” AI onto their tools – but what they end up with is a **mangled mess that can’t actually do anything useful (Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, the generic useless “AI” sidebar in every application).** Enterprises and consumers need a way to automate work directly inside of the tools they are familiar with – \*\*their solution is o11.\*\*\
\
Starting with **the entire Google & Microsoft Suite,** we’ve enabled hundreds of companies to automate presentation / spreadsheet / document generation directly within their workflow. Teams that use us no longer need to move from app to app or deal with agents that merely “provide insights.” Now they can actually do things in these tools, and do them **fast.**

# Start today:

Try o11 for Free in Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 at <https://o11.ai>. Book a demo at <https://o11.ai/book-demo>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98341&key=user_uploads/1788479/2a4f8871-f9de-4f49-9758-39a582173ea4)

# How did we come up with this?

Before we dropped out of UNC we were surrounded by finance students who all faced similar problems at their internships over the summer: Legacy software, no AI, and tons of grunt work. Most existing finance solutions thought the best way to provide workflow value was to build an external dashboard. But after speaking to hundreds of finance professionals we realized that teams don’t want an external solution, they require something that is directly within their workflow. So, we started by building a Microsoft PowerPoint plugin. Soon, financial teams started asking us for more, and we then introduced o11 For Excel and o11 For Word. But, why confine ourselves to Microsoft only? Teams that we worked with and spoke to all wanted integrations with the full G Workspace suite, and soon we built it for them in Google Slides, Docs, and Sheets. **We’re not stopping there though – while these productivity suites are a large part of our user’s workflows, their workflows aren’t just confined to these tools.**

Our users use thousands of enterprise legacy apps that need automation, not duct-taped AI. That’s why, the product we’re soon going to release will enable you to use o11 in any app — **it’s going to enable you** **to automate directly inside any workflow.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/30e770cd-ac0d-4853-9d5c-40b1cb0f9615)

# [**🕺**](https://emojipedia.org/man-dancing)**The Team**

[**Nolan (Founder & CEO)**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nolan-rossi/) – triple majored in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Astrophysics, and Business Administration through UC Berkeley’s M.E.T. program, graduating in three years. He previously worked as a software development engineer at Amazon and ran a software consultancy he scaled to $250k in revenue. As a fourth-generation member of a family construction business, Nolan saw firsthand how difficult it is for contractors to consistently find new work — and how little time they have to sit down and bid on projects while managing active jobs. Scout Out was built to solve that problem.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/6d9cfed3-6baf-4fac-b9b7-ec2a2d99a6de)

# **❌ The Problem**

Residential contractors are running complex businesses on a patchwork of tools that were never built for construction.

* **Project management is fragmented.** Plans live in email. Estimates live in spreadsheets. Photos live on phones. Proposals get copy-pasted from old Word docs. Nothing talks to anything else.
* **Estimating is slow and error-prone.** Reading through plans, measuring takeoffs, pricing labor and materials, then assembling a professional proposal — this process takes hours and still produces mistakes. Contractors either underbid to win, or overbid to be safe, and lose anyway.
* **AI tools exist but aren't built for construction.** Generic project management software ignores the realities of field work — plan sets, per-page takeoffs, scope changes mid-build, subcontractor coordination.

  Contractors end up duct-taping tools together and paying the price in margin and stress.

**The result:** Jobs are won with incomplete bids, managed with ad-hoc systems, and closed with manual paperwork that eats hours contractors don't have.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/0cdecb42-5772-4e1d-81d1-1d7fb87db86d)

# **🙌 Our Solution: One Platform for the Entire Job**

Scout Out is a single platform that handles the full lifecycle of a construction job — from first estimate to final invoice — with AI doing the heavy lifting.

### Job & Customer Hub 🏗️

Everything lives in one place, organized around the job:

* Customer records and full contact history
* All uploads in one place: plans, photos, permits, contracts, and insurance
* Status tracking across every deliverable and milestone
* Every conversation, change order, and document tied to the right job

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/ffbb3afc-3a3e-425d-800a-23c7fc95413a)

### Instant AI-Powered Bidding ⚡

When a contractor finds a project they want, ScoutOut generates a **clean, editable quote in seconds**.

* Upload plans, photos, or a short description
* AI produces a structured estimate covering scope, labor, and materials
* Contractors can review, adjust, and send a professional bid immediately

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/cf8c8b3c-0744-4b8b-b092-16e0952bf102)

### Built for Real Contractor Workflows 🔧

ScoutOut is designed for how contractors actually work:

* No long setup or training
* Quotes are editable and contractor-owned
* Built to be used between site visits, calls, and active builds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97506&key=user_uploads/2106935/f723d694-6721-4b5a-a80a-4bd39e691892)
